faqs.q: How many gummies are in a 1000mg THC package and what is the dose per piece?
faqs.a: The number of gummies and per-piece dose in a 1000mg THC package varies by producer. Common configurations include 100 gummies at 10mg each, 40 gummies at 25mg each, 20 gummies at 50mg each, or 10 gummies at 100mg each. Standard recreational cannabis gummy doses are generally considered 5–10mg THC for new or low-tolerance consumers, 10–25mg for moderate experience, and 25–50mg for high tolerance. A single 10mg piece from a 100-count package is a reasonable starting point; a single piece from a 10-count 100mg package would be an extreme dose for most consumers. Always check the per-piece dose from the product's packaging before consuming and start with one piece at the lower end of the milligram range.

faqs.q: Why does eating THC gummies feel different and stronger than smoking or vaping?
faqs.a: When you inhale THC through smoking or vaping, it enters the bloodstream through the lungs and reaches the brain within minutes, producing a rapid onset effect that typically peaks within 30 to 60 minutes. When you eat THC in a gummy, it must first be digested, absorbed through the intestinal wall, and processed by the liver before entering the bloodstream. The liver converts Delta-9 THC into 11-hydroxy-THC — a metabolite that crosses the blood-brain barrier more effectively and produces an effect that many consumers describe as more intense, more body-heavy, and significantly longer-lasting than inhaled Delta-9 THC. This metabolic conversion, combined with the delayed 45 to 90 minute onset, explains why edibles at the same milligram dose feel stronger and last longer than inhaled cannabis. The 1000mg total in this package means individual dose management and patience are both critical.

faqs.q: What should I do if I consume too much from a 1000mg gummy package?
faqs.a: If you have consumed more THC from these gummies than intended and are experiencing an uncomfortable effect — such as racing heart, anxiety, paranoia, dizziness, or feeling overwhelmed — the most important thing to know is that the experience is temporary and will resolve as the THC metabolises. No one has died from cannabis overconsumption alone. Find a quiet, comfortable, and safe environment. Lie down if needed. CBD, if available, may help moderate the THC effect by engaging endocannabinoid receptors. Black pepper (chewing a few peppercorns) is a folk remedy some consumers find helpful for anxiety from overconsumption due to its terpene profile. Stay hydrated with water. Avoid alcohol, which amplifies THC effects. The peak effect from edibles typically occurs 2 to 3 hours after consumption and then gradually diminishes, though residual effects can last 6 to 8 hours at high doses.

faqs.q: What is Delta-8 THC and how does it differ from regular (Delta-9) THC?
faqs.a: Delta-8 THC (tetrahydrocannabinol) is a minor cannabinoid naturally present in small amounts in cannabis. It binds to CB1 receptors with lower affinity than Delta-9 THC, producing milder psychoactive effects — typically described as 70–80% of Delta-9's potency. Key differences: reduced anxiety and paranoia risk; clearer, more functional high; shorter duration; and often more body-focused than cerebral effects. Delta-8 is also hemp-derived and federally legal in many US jurisdictions under the 2018 Farm Bill.

The 900mg size may run 250–400+ standard puffs depending on draw length.

faqs.q: How should medical patients dose from a 1500mg THC gummy package?
faqs.a: Medical patients using a 1500mg THC gummy package should first identify the per-piece milligram dose from the packaging, then determine their therapeutic daily dose through consultation with a healthcare provider or through careful self-titration starting at a low dose. A typical therapeutic starting dose for new edible users is 5–10mg; most medical applications for pain, sleep, or appetite management settle in the 10–30mg range for moderate tolerance, and higher for experienced consumers with significant tolerance. To find your dose in a high-potency package, start by cutting one piece into quarters and consuming one quarter at a time with 90 minutes between each increment. Never assume the package is not working during the first 90 minutes.

faqs.q: How do I store the 1500mg THC Gummy package to maintain potency and texture?
faqs.a: Store the 1500mg THC Gummy package sealed in a cool, dark place — ideally a refrigerator, especially after opening. Cannabis-infused gummies are sensitive to heat and humidity: heat can cause gummies to melt together and pool THC unevenly through the mass, while humidity can cause them to become sticky and difficult to separate cleanly. Both conditions compromise accurate per-piece dosing. Keep the package away from direct sunlight, which can degrade cannabinoids over time. Properly stored, cannabis gummies typically retain potency for up to 12 months. If gummies have melted and re-solidified, the THC distribution may be uneven — cut and weigh by mass rather than piece count for most accurate dosing.

faqs.q: What does the 1:1 THC:CBD ratio in Mood gummies do compared to THC-only gummies?
faqs.a: CBD in a 1:1 ratio with THC modulates the THC experience through several mechanisms. CBD has weak antagonist activity at CB1 receptors — the same receptors THC activates — which blunts some of THC's more intense psychoactive effects and particularly reduces the anxiety and paranoia that high-THC products can produce in some consumers. CBD also extends the effective duration of THC by inhibiting the enzymes that break it down in the body. The net effect for most consumers is a more balanced, functional, and sustainable high compared to the same THC milligram dose without CBD — less intense peak psychoactivity, less risk of anxiety, and a longer-lasting pleasant effect. This is why 1:1 products are often recommended for consumers who enjoy cannabis but find pure THC products occasionally too intense or anxiety-inducing.

faqs.q: Is 15mg of Delta-9 THC per gummy appropriate for beginners?
faqs.a: 15mg of Delta-9 THC per piece is above the standard beginner dose range. Most cannabis educators recommend 2.5–5mg as a first dose for new edible consumers and 5–10mg for those with some experience but limited edible history. At 15mg, a consumer with no previous cannabis tolerance may experience significant psychoactivity — euphoria, altered time perception, and physical heaviness — that could be overwhelming. The 15mg CBD alongside the THC provides some moderation of the effect and reduces anxiety risk compared to 15mg THC alone, but a beginner would still be better served starting with half a gummy (7.5mg D9 + 7.5mg CBD) and waiting the full 90 minutes before assessing whether more is needed. In 1906 Delta 9 THC and CBD Drops – Bliss, Kanna works alongside the THC's euphoric properties and the CBD's anxiety-moderating effect to create a compound mood response that no single ingredient achieves on its own. faqs.q: How does Bliss differ from the other 1906 Drops that also contain THC and CBD?

The Kanna and Theobromine in 1906 Delta 9 THC and CBD Drops – Bliss target the social anxiety and emotional openness dimension that other formulas do not address. faqs.q: What role does CBG play in Genius that the other 1906 Drops do not have?
faqs.a: CBG, or cannabigerol, is unique to the Genius formula within the 1906 lineup and is specifically included for its associations with neuroprotection and cognitive support. Unlike CBD, which primarily moderates THC's psychoactivity, CBG interacts with endocannabinoid receptors in ways that may support neural health and focus — early research has explored its potential role in neuroinflammation and cognitive function. The three-cannabinoid combination in 1906 Delta 9 THC, CBD, and CBG Drops – Genius creates a more complete endocannabinoid system engagement than any two-cannabinoid formula achieves, and this third dimension is what gives Genius its distinct cognitive character compared to the mood-oriented Bliss or the energy-oriented Go.

faqs.q: How does Bacopa Monnieri affect the timeline of the Genius cognitive effect?
faqs.a: Bacopa Monnieri is an Ayurvedic adaptogen known for effects on memory consolidation and neural communication, but it has a notably slower onset than the cannabinoids or stimulant botanicals in the Genius formula. While the THC, CBD, and CBG components of 1906 Delta 9 THC, CBD, and CBG Drops – Genius reach effect within 20 to 30 minutes, the Bacopa builds over 40 to 60 minutes and its cognitive support strengthens with consistent use over time. Regular Genius users typically notice increasing cognitive benefit the more consistently they use it, rather than hitting a flat plateau after the first few sessions. For single-use sessions, the Rhodiola and L-Theanine provide the more immediate cognitive support while Bacopa contributes to the longer arc.

faqs.q: How does 1906 Genius compare to standalone nootropic supplements for cognitive work?
faqs.a: Traditional nootropic supplements use compounds like Bacopa, Rhodiola, and L-Theanine without any cannabinoid component, which means they engage none of the endocannabinoid system's documented role in mood, motivation, and neural signalling. 1906 Delta 9 THC, CBD, and CBG Drops – Genius bridges both categories by combining the established nootropic botanical stack with three cannabinoids in a single fast-acting tablet. faqs.q: How does 1906 Sleep compare to melatonin and antihistamine-based sleep aids?

faqs.q: Is 20mg THC per gummy too strong for a first-time edible consumer?
faqs.a: Yes — 20mg THC per piece is above the recommended starting dose for first-time cannabis edible consumers. Standard cannabis education guidance suggests 2.5mg for the most cautious start, 5mg for new consumers, and 10mg as a moderate entry point. 20mg is considered a strong dose even for consumers with regular cannabis flower experience, because oral THC produces different and more potent effects than inhaled THC through the liver's conversion to 11-hydroxy-THC. For a first-time edible user, a single 20mg Potluck gummy has a meaningful probability of producing an overwhelming experience. If these are your first edibles, cut one gummy into quarters and start with 5mg, waiting 90 minutes before considering more.

faqs.q: How does 2090 Shit compare to its siblings Cereal Milk and Gary Payton?

Cereal Milk (selected by Cookies) expresses a creamy, cereal-milk sweetness with citrus; Gary Payton (selected with the NBA player) expresses a more gas-forward, spicy, and fuel-dominant character. 2090 Shit expresses the dough/gas profile with tropical pineapple and spicy floral notes — its own distinct terpene expression from the same genetic combination.

faqs.a: 3Chi's standard Delta 8 gummies (Black Raspberry and Watermelon) contain 25mg Delta 8 THC per piece with no CBN — they produce a balanced, clear-headed Delta 8 experience appropriate for general recreational use, relaxation, and mild mood elevation. faqs.q: Why does 3Chi Comfortably Numb use Delta 8 rather than Delta 9 THC as the base?
faqs.a: Delta 8 was chosen as the base for Comfortably Numb because its effect profile is better suited to a deep relaxation and pain formula than Delta 9 at equivalent concentrations. Delta 8 binds to CB1 receptors with lower affinity than Delta 9, producing a milder, longer-lasting psychoactivity that is significantly less prone to anxiety or mental overstimulation — qualities that are counterproductive in a formula designed for rest. Delta 8 also has a more pronounced body-focused character than Delta 9 at comparable doses, which complements the CBN's sedative properties rather than competing with them. For a tincture specifically engineered to produce comfortable physical numbness, Delta 8's gentler and more body-centred psychoactivity makes it a better foundation than Delta 9.

faqs.q: How should a first-time user approach dosing 3Chi Delta 8 Comfortably Numb Tincture?
faqs.a: Start with no more than a quarter dropper held sublingually for 60 to 90 seconds, then wait a full 60 to 90 minutes before assessing — MCT oil carriers absorb more gradually than alcohol-based tinctures and the full effect can take up to 90 minutes to develop completely. At the 600mg size, a quarter dropper delivers approximately 75mg Delta 8, 75mg CBN, and 7.5mg CBC, which is a meaningful sedative dose for most users regardless of their general cannabis tolerance. The combination of Delta 8 and CBN is significantly more sedating than either cannabinoid alone, so do not assume your existing Delta 9 or CBD tolerance translates directly here. Have your bedtime routine complete before dosing — this is a lie-down-immediately product.

faqs.q: Can Comfortably Numb be used for daytime pain management?
faqs.a: For most users, 3Chi Delta 8 Comfortably Numb Tincture is not a practical daytime product because the CBN load creates sedation that meaningfully impairs alertness, coordination, and cognitive function at doses adequate for pain management. The product itself states explicitly that it is not designed for activity and that driving or operating machinery after dosing is inadvisable. For daytime pain management with cannabinoids, 3Chi's standard Delta 8 Tincture — without CBN — provides analgesic and anti-inflammatory benefits without the sedative overlay that makes Comfortably Numb incompatible with daytime function. Reserve Comfortably Numb for evening, rest-day, and pre-sleep use where full sedation is the intended and welcome outcome.

faqs.q: What makes 3Chi Delta 8 gummies different from other Delta 8 gummy brands?
faqs.a: 3Chi was the first brand to commercialise Delta 8 THC consumer products at scale and has maintained its market position through three key differentiators: the quality of their Delta 8 extraction and distillation process (resulting in a cleaner, more consistently potent product), a 100% vegan and gluten-free pectin-based formula that extends accessibility, and a fast-acting formulation specifically optimised for rapid absorption. Their gummies are widely reviewed as having zero hemp taste and delivering more consistent potency across pieces than many competing brands. 3Chi also maintains comprehensive batch-level lab testing published publicly. For consumers evaluating Delta 8 gummies, 3Chi is consistently cited as the reference standard against which other brands are measured.

faqs.q: Is black raspberry just a flavour or does it affect the experience?
faqs.a: Black raspberry in 3Chi's Delta 8 gummies is purely a flavouring choice — it has no effect on the cannabinoid content or psychoactive experience. The Delta 8 distillate used in 3Chi's formula is designed to be completely flavorless, allowing the natural and artificial black raspberry flavouring to come through without any cannabis taste interference. The choice between 3Chi's black raspberry and watermelon flavours is entirely personal preference with no difference in the Delta 8 experience. Consumers who prefer tart, dark berry flavours tend toward black raspberry; those who prefer sweet, tropical flavours tend toward watermelon.

faqs.q: How does 25mg of Delta 8 per gummy compare to Delta 9 THC in cannabis flower?
faqs.a: Delta 8 THC is estimated to produce roughly 50–70% of the psychoactive effect of Delta 9 THC at equivalent milligrams — making 25mg of Delta 8 roughly comparable to 12–17mg of Delta 9 in terms of psychoactive intensity, though individual responses vary significantly. For context: a typical cannabis flower joint consumed over 15 minutes might deliver 10–30mg of Delta 9 depending on the strain and how much is smoked; a single 25mg Delta 8 gummy is a meaningful dose in that range. However, oral Delta 8 (like all oral cannabinoids) is converted in the liver and produces longer, more sustained effects than inhaled cannabis. Consumers transitioning from flower to edibles should start with half a gummy and wait 90 minutes before the full effect develops.

faqs.q: How should I store 3Chi Watermelon Delta 8 gummies after opening?
faqs.a: 3Chi specifically recommends refrigeration after opening their Delta 8 gummies and advises against storing them above room temperature or in humid environments. Delta 8 THC gummies are particularly susceptible to heat because the Delta 8 distillate infused into the gummy matrix can liquefy at elevated temperatures, causing gummies to fuse together and pool the cannabinoid unevenly — resulting in inconsistent dosing per piece. Refrigeration keeps the gummy texture firm, prevents adhesion between pieces, and maintains even cannabinoid distribution. The sealed childproof bag helps with humidity control between uses. Gummies stored properly retain potency for up to a year. If stored in a warm environment and gummies have melted and re-solidified, potency distribution across pieces may be uneven.

faqs.q: Can I take a 3Chi Watermelon Delta 8 gummy alongside other supplements or medications?
faqs.a: This is a question that requires guidance from a healthcare provider or pharmacist rather than a general product FAQ, because Delta 8 THC interactions with specific medications depend on your individual medication list and health status. What is generally known: Delta 8 THC, like Delta 9 THC and CBD, is metabolised by the liver's cytochrome P450 enzyme system, which is also responsible for metabolising many common medications. Consuming Delta 8 alongside medications that use these same metabolic pathways can affect how quickly both the medication and the Delta 8 are processed, potentially altering the effective dose and timing of either substance. If you take any prescription medications, consult your doctor or pharmacist before adding Delta 8 THC edibles to your routine.

faqs.q: Why does the 3Chi shot absorb faster than the 3Chi gummies?
faqs.a: Liquid cannabis shots absorb faster than solid gummies for two main reasons. First, liquid passes through the stomach and reaches the small intestine faster than solid food — there is no need for the stomach's mechanical breakdown of solid material before absorption can begin. Second, the microparticle or nano-emulsified cannabinoid formats used in some liquid shots (3Chi's proprietary PolyMorph Delta 8 technology) create smaller cannabinoid droplets that absorb more readily through intestinal membranes than standard oil-based cannabinoids. Together these factors reduce onset from the typical 45–90 minute window of gummies to approximately 30–45 minutes for the shot format. For consumers who want to time their sleep onset more precisely, the faster absorption of the shot over a gummy is a meaningful practical advantage.

The shot is therefore a higher single-serving dose than a standard single-gummy serving. For consumers whose effective sleep dose from the gummies is one piece (12.5mg Delta 8 + 12.5mg CBN), the shot at double that amount will produce a more pronounced sedating effect. For consumers who regularly take two gummies, the shot matches their established dose in a faster-absorbing format. Start with the gummy version first to establish your effective Comfortably Numb dose before transitioning to the shot, to avoid over-dosing in the faster format.

faqs.q: Can the 3Chi Comfortably Numb shot be mixed into a beverage?

faqs.q: How does the Mango Citrus shot differ from the Comfortably Numb shot?
faqs.a: The 3Chi Delta 8 THC Shot Mango Citrus and Comfortably Numb shot differ in both cannabinoid composition and intended use. Mango Citrus contains 50mg of Delta 8 THC with no CBN — producing the clear-headed, functional relaxation characteristic of Delta 8 alone, without sleep sedation. Comfortably Numb contains 25mg Delta 8 + 25mg CBN, where the CBN significantly redirects the experience toward body relaxation and sleep induction. Mango Citrus is for recreational, social, or daytime-use-oriented Delta 8 sessions where staying awake and reasonably functional is the goal. Comfortably Numb is strictly a sleep and nighttime product. Neither should be used before driving or operating machinery.

faqs.q: Is 50mg of Delta 8 THC in one shot appropriate for a first-time user?
faqs.a: No — 50mg of Delta 8 THC in a single serving is a high dose appropriate only for consumers with established Delta 8 or cannabis tolerance. Delta 8 at 50mg (roughly equivalent to 25–35mg of Delta 9 in psychoactive terms) will produce significant psychoactivity for most consumers, including marked euphoria, altered perception, and physical heaviness. First-time or occasional Delta 8 users should start with a half or quarter of this shot — 12.5 to 25mg of Delta 8 — to assess tolerance before consuming a full dose. The fast-acting liquid format also means the full effect arrives faster than a gummy would, giving less time to assess and pace. 3Chi clearly advises not to drive or operate machinery after use.

faqs.q: What does 'fast-acting' mean for the 3Chi Delta 8 shot and how does it change the experience?
faqs.a: 3Chi's Delta 8 shots are formulated with their proprietary PolyMorph Delta 8 technology designed for faster absorption than standard edibles. Typical gummy onset is 45–90 minutes depending on stomach contents and individual metabolism. 3Chi states the shot begins working in approximately 30 to 45 minutes — meaningfully faster due to the liquid format clearing the stomach faster and the PolyMorph technology improving cannabinoid bioavailability. The practical difference is that the peak effect arrives earlier and the total experience timeline is somewhat compressed compared to gummies. For consumers who want to time their Delta 8 experience more precisely — knowing effects begin within 35 minutes rather than guessing whether the gummy took 45 or 90 minutes — the shot format offers better predictability.

faqs.q: How does Delta 8 THC in this tincture actually differ from Delta 9 THC in terms of what you feel?
faqs.a: Delta 8 and Delta 9 THC share nearly identical molecular structures, differing only in the position of a double bond — the 8th versus the 9th carbon in the chain. This structural difference produces a noticeably different subjective experience: Delta 8 binds to CB1 receptors with lower affinity, resulting in a milder, longer-lasting psychoactive effect that users describe as more body-focused and less cerebral than Delta 9. The anxiety and paranoia that some consumers experience with Delta 9 at higher doses are significantly reduced with Delta 8 — making 3Chi Delta 8 Tincture a practical alternative for consumers who want the relaxation and pain-modulation benefits of THC without the mental intensity. The effect also lasts longer at equivalent doses, which extends the value of each serving.

faqs.q: What is a reasonable starting dose for the 3Chi Delta 8 Tincture at 1200mg potency?
faqs.a: At approximately 40mg of Delta 8 per millilitre, even a fraction of a dropper in 3Chi Delta 8 Tincture contains a meaningful cannabinoid dose. New Delta 8 users should start with a quarter dropper — approximately 10mg — held sublingually for 60 seconds and wait a full 45 to 60 minutes for MCT absorption to complete before reassessing. Experienced Delta 9 cannabis users may begin at a half-dropper dose given their existing cannabinoid tolerance, but should still respect the onset window before adding more. The broad-spectrum secondary cannabinoid profile adds to the overall effect, so the experience will be fuller than isolated Delta 8 at the same milligram dose.

faqs.q: Can 3Chi Delta 8 Tincture be used during the day, or is it only suitable for evenings?
faqs.a: Unlike 3Chi's Comfortably Numb tincture which contains CBN and is effectively nighttime-only, 3Chi Delta 8 Tincture does not carry a significant sedative overlay at conservative doses and is practical for daytime use for regular cannabinoid consumers. At a quarter to half dropper, many experienced users report using this tincture during the day for anxiety management, mild pain relief, and creative focus without meaningful functional impairment. At larger doses the body-heaviness increases and daytime activity becomes less practical. This flexible dose range — calibrating a modest morning serving for functional use and a larger evening serving for deeper relaxation from the same bottle — is one of the main practical advantages of a single-cannabinoid high-potency Delta 8 tincture.

faqs.q: Is Delta 9 THC from hemp the same as Delta 9 THC from cannabis?
faqs.a: Yes — Delta 9 tetrahydrocannabinol is the same molecule whether it is derived from hemp or marijuana. The compound's chemical structure, pharmacological activity, and psychoactive effects are identical regardless of source plant. The distinction between hemp-derived and marijuana-derived Delta 9 THC is purely legal: hemp is defined as cannabis with less than 0.3% Delta 9 THC by dry weight, and the 2018 Farm Bill made hemp and its derivatives federally legal under that threshold. Hemp-derived Delta 9 gummies like 3Chi's are formulated with the total Delta 9 content below 0.3% of the gummy's weight while still delivering a meaningful per-piece dose. The psychoactive experience from 20mg of hemp-derived Delta 9 is functionally identical to 20mg of dispensary Delta 9 at the consumer level.

faqs.q: How does 3Chi's Delta 9 gummy compare to their Delta 8 gummy at the same milligram dose?
faqs.a: Delta 9 THC is significantly more potent than Delta 8 THC at equivalent milligram doses — Delta 8 is estimated at roughly 50–70% of Delta 9's psychoactive potency. This means 20mg of Delta 9 (one 3Chi D9 gummy) will produce noticeably stronger psychoactivity than 20mg of Delta 8. The qualitative character of the experience also differs: Delta 9 tends to produce more intense psychoactivity with a higher potential for anxiety, paranoia, and sensory alteration at equivalent doses, while Delta 8 is generally described as clearer-headed and less likely to produce anxiety. For consumers transitioning from Delta 8 to Delta 9 gummies, starting at a lower dose (half a gummy = 10mg D9) is advisable even with established Delta 8 tolerance.

faqs.q: Can 3Chi Delta 9 gummies ship to all US states?
faqs.a: 3Chi publishes a list of states they ship hemp-derived Delta 9 products to on their website, and this list changes as state laws evolve. As hemp-derived products, 3Chi Delta 9 gummies are federally legal under the 2018 Farm Bill, but individual states have enacted varying regulations around Delta 9 THC products regardless of source. Some states have specifically banned hemp-derived Delta 9 or impose restrictions on per-package milligram limits. Consumers should verify current availability in their state on 3Chi's website at the time of purchase. Gauldentrap ships these products in compliance with applicable laws; customers are responsible for understanding their local regulations before ordering.

faqs.q: Can 3Chi Delta 9 gummies cause a positive drug test?
faqs.a: Yes — 3Chi Delta 9 THC gummies contain real Delta-9 THC, which is the primary compound detected by standard cannabis drug tests. Consuming 3Chi Delta 9 gummies can result in a positive THC drug test depending on the dose consumed, frequency of use, and the sensitivity of the test. Consumers subject to drug testing for employment, sports, or legal reasons should not use Delta 9 THC products of any kind. This applies equally to all hemp-derived Delta 9 products regardless of brand.

faqs.q: What is the right dose of 3Chi Delta 9 gummies for someone transitioning from Delta 8?

If your established Delta 8 dose is one full 25mg gummy, starting with half a 20mg Delta 9 gummy (10mg Delta 9) is a conservative and appropriate approach. Allow the full 90 minutes for onset before assessing whether more is needed. Oral Delta 9 converted in the liver to 11-hydroxy-THC can feel significantly stronger than the same milligram dose of Delta 8, and the transition should be made cautiously.

faqs.q: Is 20mg of Delta 9 THC per gummy appropriate for someone who only uses CBD?

faqs.q: Why is watermelon such a popular flavour in hemp gummy products?
faqs.a: Watermelon is one of the most universally appealing fruit flavours in the candy and gummy category precisely because it is light, sweet, and non-polarising — unlike tart or sour profiles that not all consumers enjoy, or stronger berry flavours that some find artificial. The high water content of real watermelon makes its natural flavour profile bright and refreshing rather than heavy, and the sweetness is balanced rather than cloying. In cannabis gummies specifically, watermelon's lightness works particularly well because it does not compete with or amplify any residual hemp character from the extract. 3Chi's Delta 9 watermelon gummy benefits from flavorless distillate that lets the watermelon character come through completely unimpeded.

faqs.q: Is the 3Chi Delta 9 Watermelon gummy safe to combine with alcohol?
faqs.a: Combining Delta 9 THC gummies with alcohol is not recommended and can significantly amplify the psychoactive effects of both substances beyond what either produces independently. Alcohol can increase the rate of THC absorption and elevate blood THC concentrations, while THC can intensify some effects of alcohol. The combination produces an unpredictable and often overwhelming experience — particularly at a 20mg Delta 9 dose — that is associated with substantially higher rates of anxiety, nausea, dizziness, and what is commonly called 'greening out.' If you choose to use both, do so with extreme caution, starting with very small amounts of each, in a safe and comfortable environment without plans to drive or operate machinery.

faqs.q: How long do 3Chi Delta 9 Watermelon gummies last before expiring?
faqs.a: 3Chi Delta 9 gummies properly stored in a cool, dark place — such as a refrigerator — retain potency for approximately 12 months from the manufacturing date. 3Chi recommends refrigeration after opening specifically because heat and humidity are the primary factors that degrade gummy texture and cannabinoid potency over time. At room temperature and away from direct sunlight, gummies typically maintain potency for 6 to 9 months. Unopened packages stored properly approach the 12-month mark reliably. The primary indicator of degradation is changes in gummy texture (becoming overly hard or sticky) or flavour changes rather than potency loss, which occurs more gradually.

faqs.a: Skyhio is a sister brand of 3Chi — it was established by the same team to expand the Delta 8 THC gummy flavour range beyond the two flavours (black raspberry and watermelon) that 3Chi offers under its primary brand. Both brands operate to the same quality standard: same US-grown hemp-derived Delta 8 distillate, same vegan pectin formula, same COA publishing, same 3Chi-quality extraction. Skyhio was created to address consumer demand for additional flavour variety in the Delta 8 gummy category without changing the core formula. Strawberry is the signature Skyhio flavour. Consumers who have experience with 3Chi Delta 8 gummies will find the Skyhio strawberry gummies functionally identical in potency and effect, with a different fruit character.

faqs.q: Why do Delta 8 gummies from Skyhio need cold shipping in warm climates?
faqs.a: Delta 8 THC distillate has a relatively low melting point and the gummy matrix that carries it can soften and liquify at temperatures common during summer shipping in warm regions. When gummies melt in transit, the Delta 8 distillate can migrate within the gummy mass and redistribute unevenly across pieces — meaning some gummies end up with more than 25mg and others with less, undermining the dosing consistency that precise-dose edibles are designed to provide. Skyhio offers seasonal cold shipping (requiring UPS shipping) to prevent this. Even without melting during transit, refrigeration after opening is recommended to maintain gummy texture and prevent pieces from fusing together in warm conditions.

faqs.q: How does the strawberry Skyhio Delta 8 gummy compare to Skyhio's other flavours?
faqs.a: Skyhio's strawberry is the brand's signature and most widely available flavour — it is the primary offering that differentiated Skyhio from 3Chi's core black raspberry and watermelon options. Skyhio may offer additional flavours depending on availability, but strawberry is the consistent flagship. In terms of Delta 8 experience, Skyhio strawberry gummies perform identically to 3Chi's Delta 8 gummies at the same 25mg per piece dose — the euphoric, clear-headed relaxation and calming body buzz are a function of the Delta 8 distillate, not the flavouring. faqs.q: What is THCV and why does 3Chi combine it with Delta 8?
faqs.a: THCV (tetrahydrocannabivarin) is a minor cannabinoid found in cannabis that has an unusual dose-dependent effect profile. At lower doses, THCV tends to act as a CB1 receptor antagonist — it can actually counteract some of THC's effects, particularly appetite stimulation and sedation. At higher doses it shifts to CB1 agonist activity with its own psychoactive character. 3Chi combines THCV with Delta 8 at the specific 2:1 Delta 8:THCV ratio (20mg:10mg per piece) to leverage both cannabinoids' effects simultaneously: Delta 8 provides mild euphoria and relaxation while THCV contributes its reported energy, focus, and appetite-suppressing qualities. Together the combination produces an uplifting, focused, stress-reducing effect that is more activating than standard Delta 8 gummies. THCV has been called 'diet weed' in popular culture due to its appetite-suppressing properties at these doses.

faqs.q: Will the THCV in these gummies suppress my appetite?
faqs.a: Appetite suppression is one of the most commonly reported effects of THCV at doses similar to the 10mg per gummy in 3Chi's THCV Gummies. Unlike standard Delta 9 or Delta 8 products, which typically stimulate appetite, THCV at lower doses appears to antagonise the appetite-stimulating activity of the endocannabinoid system. Consumer reports suggest that the THCV in the 3Chi formula noticeably reduces the 'munchies' effect that Delta 8 or Delta 9 gummies alone would produce. Individual responses vary based on body weight, metabolism, and personal endocannabinoid system differences — some consumers notice significant appetite reduction, others less so. Consumers actively seeking appetite stimulation from cannabis edibles should choose 3Chi's standard Delta 8 or Delta 9 gummies instead.

faqs.q: Are 3Chi THCV gummies appropriate for daytime use?
faqs.a: Yes — 3Chi's THCV Gummies are better suited to daytime or afternoon use than their standard Delta 8 gummies. The THCV component adds an energising, focusing dimension that counteracts the mild sedation that Delta 8 alone can produce. While standard Delta 8 gummies are primarily positioned for relaxation and may cause drowsiness at full doses, the Delta 8 + THCV combination in these gummies is positioned for the uplifting, productive, stress-managed daytime experience. Consumers who find standard Delta 8 gummies too sedating during work or active hours but want some cannabinoid support for stress and focus find the THCV gummies a more functional option. Start with half a gummy to assess how the Delta 8 + THCV combination affects you personally before committing to a full piece.

faqs.q: Why does Sugar Jack's use manuka honey in their gummies?
faqs.a: Manuka honey is a premium honey produced by bees that pollinate the Manuka (Leptospermum scoparium) plant in New Zealand and Australia. It is notable for containing methylglyoxal (MGO) at significantly higher concentrations than standard honey, which gives it documented antimicrobial properties. In Sugar Jack's gummies, manuka honey serves multiple purposes: it contributes to flavour complexity and natural sweetness with more depth than standard corn syrup alone, it has a slightly lower glycemic effect than refined sugar, and its premium ingredient status aligns with Sugar Jack's positioning as a handcrafted, quality-first edible brand. The manuka honey in the formula is a differentiating ingredient that contributes to the better-than-average taste quality reviewers consistently note when comparing Sugar Jack's gummies to other Canadian high-dose edibles.

faqs.q: What does nano-emulsification mean for Sugar Jack's gummies?
faqs.a: Nano-emulsification is a process that breaks THC oil into microscopic nano-sized droplets and encapsulates them in a water-compatible shell. Standard cannabis oil is hydrophobic — it does not dissolve in water and resists absorption in the water-based digestive system. Nano-emulsified THC has dramatically smaller particle sizes that absorb more readily through intestinal walls, potentially increasing bioavailability (the proportion of ingested THC that reaches the bloodstream) and reducing onset time compared to standard oil-based THC edibles. For Sugar Jack's, nano-emulsification contributes to the consistent dosing they market — smaller, more uniformly distributed THC particles within each gummy means every piece contains a more evenly distributed dose rather than potential pockets of oil concentration found in some standard-process edibles.

faqs.q: Is 50mg THC per gummy safe for first-time users?
faqs.a: No — 50mg THC per piece is an advanced dose appropriate only for experienced cannabis consumers with high established tolerance. For context, Health Canada and most cannabis health authorities recommend 2.5mg as the starting dose for first-time cannabis edible consumers and 5–10mg for those with some experience. 50mg is five to twenty times the recommended beginner dose. For experienced cannabis consumers whose regular dose is 10–25mg Delta 9 THC, a full 50mg Sugar Jack's gummy may also be too much — start with one-quarter (approximately 12.5mg) and assess over 90 minutes before consuming more. Sugar Jack's specifically advises not to eat the whole bag as it contains 500mg of THC total.

faqs.q: How do I determine the right dose from a 500mg THC gummy package?
faqs.a: First, check the package for per-piece dose information — a 500mg total package might contain anywhere from 5 to 20 pieces depending on the producer's configuration. Once you know the per-piece dose (e.g., 50mg each or 25mg each), compare it to your established effective cannabis dose. For medical patients who regularly use 25–50mg THC daily for therapeutic purposes, one piece from the appropriate configuration is your starting point. For recreational consumers, 10mg Delta 9 is a solid moderate recreational dose — if your package has 50mg per piece, a fifth of a piece is a conservative moderate dose. Never assume because the package says 500mg that any individual piece is a safe starting amount; always identify and calculate the per-piece dose first.

faqs.q: What is the difference between 500mg THC gummies and 500mg THC in a concentrate?
faqs.a: A 500mg THC gummy package and 500mg THC in a concentrate (like wax or diamonds) deliver the same total cannabinoid load but through radically different routes and timelines. The gummies are oral — onset is 45–90 minutes, effects last 4–8+ hours, and the liver conversion to 11-hydroxy-THC makes the experience feel stronger and more body-dominant than equivalent inhaled THC. A 500mg THC concentrate is consumed through dabbing or vaporising — onset is within minutes, effects peak in 15–30 minutes, and duration is 1–3 hours depending on dose. Neither format is 'stronger' inherently; they produce different timelines and character of experience from the same total cannabinoid amount. For medical patients seeking long-duration relief (8+ hours of sleep), oral gummies are often preferred over concentrates requiring repeated dosing.

faqs.q: Is 500mg THC appropriate for one person in a single day?
faqs.a: 500mg total THC represents an entire package — it is not intended as a single daily consumption amount for most people. Even for high-tolerance medical cannabis consumers using 50–100mg THC daily for therapeutic purposes, a full 500mg package represents 5 to 10 days of supply. Consuming the entire contents of a 500mg gummy package in one day would constitute extreme overconsumption for virtually anyone and could produce several hours of severely uncomfortable or distressing psychoactive effects. The 500mg total is designed to provide multiple therapeutic or recreational sessions across multiple days or weeks. Always store unused portions appropriately (cool, dark, sealed) and consume one piece at your established dose per session.

faqs.q: Are 50mg THC yogurt gummies safe to use if I normally take CBD gummies?

faqs.q: What is a 510-thread battery and why do I need one?
faqs.a: A 510-thread battery is the power source for standard 510-thread vape cartridges — the most common vape cartridge format globally. The '510' refers to the 10-thread screw connection at 5mm diameter. Without a battery, 510-thread cartridges (including all 3Chi and similar cartridges in this catalogue) cannot be used. The Hooti Extracts 510 battery provides the power, activation, and voltage control needed to heat the cartridge's heating element.

faqs.q: Does the Hooti 510 battery support variable voltage?
faqs.a: Variable voltage 510 batteries allow users to adjust the heating power — lower voltage (2.4–2.6V) for more flavourful, terpene-preserving draws; higher voltage (3.0–3.6V) for denser, larger vapour clouds. The Hooti Extracts 510 battery is designed for use with their premium cannabis cartridges and supports the voltage range appropriate for quality cannabis distillate and terpene preservation.

faqs.q: Is the Hooti 510 battery compatible with all cartridges in this catalogue?
faqs.a: Yes — all 510-thread vape cartridges use the same standard 510-thread connection. The Hooti Extracts battery is compatible with all 3Chi, Buddies, Jetty, and other 510-thread cartridges in the Gauldentrap catalogue. Standard cartridges simply screw into the Hooti 510 connection for immediate use.

faqs.q: How do I use a 510 vape battery with a cartridge?
faqs.a: Simple operation: screw the 510-thread cartridge clockwise onto the battery connection until snug (do not overtighten); most 510 batteries activate by pressing the power button 5 times to turn on; hold the button while drawing from the cartridge mouthpiece; release the button when the draw is complete; press 5 times to turn off when not in use. USB charging via the provided cable maintains battery charge.

faqs.q: What makes Acapulco Gold historically significant in cannabis culture?
faqs.a: Acapulco Gold was the most sought-after and expensive cannabis available in the US during the 1960s and 1970s, when it was smuggled from Mexico's Pacific coast and sold at premium prices to a generation of cannabis consumers who had never experienced anything like its potency and quality. It was referenced in songs, films, and literature of the era as the pinnacle of cannabis experience. Acapulco Gold is literally where modern cannabis connoisseurship began — it established that cannabis could be a premium, artisanal product and inspired the cultivation innovations that produced today's cannabis diversity.

faqs.q: What are Acapulco Gold's effects and why are they considered exceptional?
faqs.a: Acapulco Gold's pure sativa genetics produce an intensely euphoric, creative, mentally stimulating, and energising experience with remarkable clarity — described consistently as one of the clearest-headed, most creatively inspirational, and positively euphoric cannabis experiences available. The absence of significant indica genetics means no physical sedation or couch-lock — this is pure mental elevation and creative engagement. The toffee-caramel aromatic profile adds a distinctive flavour pleasure that enhances the overall experience.

faqs.q: Is the Acapulco Gold available today the same as the original 1960s landrace?
faqs.a: True original Acapulco Gold genetics from Mexico have been largely lost or interbred with modern cultivated strains. Most Acapulco Gold available today represents stabilised seed bank genetics that attempt to preserve the original landrace character — breeders like Sensi Seeds have worked to maintain authentic characteristics. The quality and effect profile depends significantly on the specific seed genetics used. At premium cultivation quality, even modern Acapulco Gold retains the distinctive golden appearance and clear-headed sativa excellence the original was famous for.

faqs.q: What makes Afghani Kush a foundational strain in cannabis genetics?
faqs.a: Afghani (Hindu Kush) landrace strains are the genetic origin of virtually all modern indica cannabis. Breeders in the 1970s and 1980s brought Afghani seeds from the Hindu Kush region to the West and began crossing them with sativa landraces to create the first hybrid strains. OG Kush, Northern Lights, Blueberry, Hash Plant, and countless other celebrated strains have Afghani genetics in their lineage. Afghani Kush represents the pure, unhybridised genetic root from which modern cannabis diversity grew — an important part of cannabis botanical history.

faqs.q: Who is Afghani Kush most appropriate for?

The pure indica experience is not appropriate for new cannabis consumers or for any daytime use — the heavy couch-lock and sedation are intense even at AA grade.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Alison Wonderland 2000MG CBD and the Full Spectrum version?
faqs.a: Alison Wonderland 2000MG CBD is a CBD isolate product — it contains only cannabidiol extracted and isolated from other hemp compounds, with no THC, no minor cannabinoids, and no terpenes. If you need guaranteed zero THC for drug testing purposes, the 2000MG CBD isolate is the safer choice.

faqs.q: How should I approach dosing Alison Wonderland 2000MG CBD for the first time at this potency?

CBD has a wide therapeutic window and is generally considered safe at high doses, but calibrating properly from the start allows you to find your minimum effective dose and make the bottle last longer.

faqs.q: Why would someone choose 2000MG CBD over lower-potency options in the Alison Wonderland range?

faqs.q: What should a first-time CBD user expect from Alison Wonderland 500MG CBD?

faqs.q: Can Alison Wonderland 500MG CBD be added to food or drinks instead of taken sublingually?

faqs.q: Will the trace THC in Alison Wonderland 500MG Full Spectrum CBD show up on a drug test?
faqs.a: Alison Wonderland 500MG Full Spectrum CBD contains trace amounts of Delta 9 THC below the 0.3% legal hemp threshold, which is a very small amount but is not zero. Standard drug tests screen for THC metabolites rather than THC itself, and even trace THC from a full-spectrum product can accumulate in the body with daily use to levels detectable by a urine immunoassay test. For consumers in workplace drug testing situations, the CBD isolate version (Alison Wonderland 500MG CBD) is the safer choice since it contains no detectable THC. faqs.q: What is the entourage effect and does it apply to Alison Wonderland 500MG Full Spectrum CBD?
faqs.a: The entourage effect is the observed phenomenon where cannabinoids, terpenes, and other plant compounds in cannabis interact synergistically to produce effects that differ from — and are often more nuanced than — any single compound in isolation. In Alison Wonderland 500MG Full Spectrum CBD, the trace THC, CBG, CBN, CBC, and hemp terpenes present alongside the primary CBD all engage the endocannabinoid system and related physiological pathways in their own right, while also modifying how the CBD itself behaves at the receptor level. The practical outcome is that many users find full-spectrum CBD at 500mg produces a more complete therapeutic effect than 500mg CBD isolate, even though the total CBD milligrams are identical. Whether this difference is meaningful for any individual depends on their specific condition and sensitivity.

faqs.q: How does Alison Wonderland Full Spectrum CBD compare to the plain CBD and 1:1 versions in the same range?
faqs.a: The Alison Wonderland range offers three different formulation philosophies at 500mg: the isolate CBD version contains only pure cannabidiol, the 1:1 THC/CBD version contains equal amounts of both cannabinoids with the intentional psychoactive component of balanced THC, and the Full Spectrum version sits between them — it contains the full hemp plant profile including trace THC but without the intentional equal-ratio THC of the 1:1 product. Full Spectrum is the best choice for users who want the complexity of whole-plant extraction without a significant psychoactive effect. If you want guaranteed no THC, choose the isolate. If you want deliberate balanced THC/CBD therapy, choose the 1:1. If you want the entourage benefit with minimal but non-zero THC, Full Spectrum is the right option.

faqs.q: What strains were crossed to create Animal Cookies and who bred it?
faqs.a: Animal Cookies was bred by BC Bud Depot, a Canadian seed bank from British Columbia, by crossing Girl Scout Cookies (GSC) with Fire OG. GSC is a cross of Durban Poison and OG Kush that became one of the defining strains of the 2010s cannabis scene — celebrated for its sweet cookie aroma, balanced euphoria, and body ease. Fire OG is an OG Kush × San Fernando Valley OG cross known as one of the most potent OG Kush phenotypes, producing intensely sedating indica effects and a sharp citrus-fuel aroma. BC Bud Depot's combination of these two powerhouse strains produces Animal Cookies: an indica-dominant hybrid with exceptional THC content (22–28%), complex multi-layered aromatics, and the deeply sedating body effect that makes it particularly valuable for medical cannabis patients.

faqs.q: What makes Animal Cookies such an effective medical cannabis strain?
faqs.a: Animal Cookies earns its medical cannabis reputation through the combination of high THC content (22–28%), indica-dominant genetics, and a terpene profile that supports its therapeutic applications. The Fire OG parent contributes potent sedation that translates directly to insomnia management — reviewers consistently note that Animal Cookies provides sleep where other strains fall short. The GSC lineage provides the euphoric mood lift that addresses depression and stress before the sedation takes over. The Caryophyllene-forward terpene profile adds anti-inflammatory CB2 receptor activity relevant to pain and inflammation management. The high THC content amplifies appetite stimulation (relevant for conditions causing appetite loss) and provides analgesic effects at the concentrations naturally present in this strain.

faqs.q: How does Animal Cookies compare to GSC as a strain for experienced consumers?
faqs.a: Animal Cookies is generally considered the more potent and more heavily indica of the two strains. GSC is a balanced hybrid (Durban Poison × OG Kush) with euphoric, creative, and socially engaging properties alongside indica body ease — it is more versatile and usable across different times of day. Animal Cookies shifts the balance significantly toward indica sedation through the Fire OG parent, making it less versatile but more effective for specific applications like insomnia and severe pain where maximum body effect is the goal. The sweet cookie aroma of GSC carries through into Animal Cookies, but the sour, pungent Fire OG character overlays it, making the overall aromatic profile more complex and less purely sweet than GSC alone. Experienced consumers who enjoy GSC for daytime or social use should treat Animal Cookies as an evening-only, high-tolerance strain.

faqs.q: What genetics produced Animal Face and why did it win the 2022 Emerald Cup?
faqs.a: Animal Face was bred by Seed Junky Genetics — one of the most respected breeding houses in California — from Face Off OG (a clone-only OG Kush phenotype famous for extreme piney-gas potency) crossed with Animal Mints (itself a GSC × Animal Cookies × SinMint Cookies cross). faqs.q: What makes AO Extracts live resin different from other Chemdawg concentrates?
faqs.a: The key distinction of AO Extracts Live Resin – Chem Dawg versus standard Chemdawg concentrates like BHO shatter or distillate is the fresh-frozen starting material. AO Extracts uses cannabis that is harvested and immediately flash-frozen rather than dried and cured, which preserves the complete volatile terpene profile as it exists in the living plant. Chemdawg is particularly notable for its pungent, complex terpene expression — the diesel, chemical, earthy, and citrus notes that define the strain's signature aroma begin degrading the moment the plant is cut. Standard BHO and distillate production from dried material loses a significant portion of these volatiles. Live resin from Chem Dawg captures the strain as it actually smells in full bloom, producing a far more aromatically accurate and terpene-rich concentrate than post-harvest extraction methods.

faqs.q: What should I expect from the effects of Chemdawg live resin?
faqs.a: Chemdawg is classified as an indica-leaning hybrid with effects that typically present in two sequential phases rather than simultaneously. The initial onset is sharply cerebral — within 5 to 10 minutes of inhalation you can expect noticeable mental stimulation, euphoria, and a head-focused intensity that distinguishes Chemdawg from gentler hybrids. This cerebral phase generally holds for 45 to 90 minutes before the body relaxation component arrives. In live resin form the terpene concentration is higher than flower, which amplifies both the aromatic complexity and the entourage effect — the Caryophyllene's CB2 anti-inflammatory activity, the Myrcene's body-ease contribution, and the Limonene's mood elevation all work more pronounced at live resin potency. New users and those with lower THC tolerance should start with a very small dab given the elevated potency.

faqs.q: How should Chem Dawg live resin be stored and consumed for best results?
faqs.a: AO Extracts Live Resin – Chem Dawg 1g Med should be stored in its sealed container in a cool, dark place — ideally a refrigerator — to preserve the volatile terpene compounds that define the live resin's aromatic character. Exposure to heat and light degrades terpenes rapidly in concentrates, which is especially significant for live resin where terpene preservation is the entire point of the production method. For consumption, dabbing at lower temperatures (around 315 to 450°F) preserves more of the terpene flavour profile than high-temperature dabs that burn off volatile aromatics before they can be inhaled. Cold-start dabbing, where the concentrate is loaded before the nail is heated, is particularly effective for capturing the full flavour range of a terpene-rich live resin like this Chem Dawg.

faqs.q: What is the #1 phenotype designation in AO Extracts GSC #1 live resin?
faqs.a: The #1 designation in AO Extracts Live Resin – GSC #1 indicates that AO Extracts selected a specific phenotype of Girl Scout Cookies — phenotype number one — from multiple plant expressions of the same genetics. Cannabis seeds from the same strain can express meaningfully different terpene profiles, potency levels, and growth characteristics depending on which genetic combination each seed expresses. Extractors often run multiple phenotypes side by side, evaluate them for terpene character, yield, and extract quality, and then designate their preferred expression for production. The #1 phenotype is the one AO Extracts identified as producing the most desirable live resin — the specific GSC expression they found best captures the strain's signature sweet and earthy aromatic character in concentrate form.

faqs.q: How does Girl Scout Cookies live resin compare to GSC distillate in terms of flavour and effect?
faqs.a: GSC distillate is a highly refined extract where the cannabis oil is heated and re-condensed to isolate specific cannabinoids — typically THC — while stripping out most or all of the terpenes. Any flavour in a distillate cartridge comes from terpenes added back after extraction, which may be cannabis-derived or botanical in origin. AO Extracts Live Resin – GSC #1 starts with fresh-frozen flower and preserves the complete native terpene profile of the plant — no stripping, no re-addition, just the compounds as they existed in the living flower. The practical difference is significant: GSC live resin delivers the full aromatic complexity of fresh Girl Scout Cookies flower, including the subtle woody, spice, and earthy layers beneath the signature sweetness that distillate formats cannot replicate.

faqs.q: What effects should I expect from GSC #1 live resin?
faqs.a: Girl Scout Cookies is a balanced hybrid — a cross of Durban Poison (sativa) and OG Kush (indica hybrid) — that typically delivers euphoric cerebral uplift balanced with physical body relaxation. In live resin form with intact terpenes at higher concentration than flower, both dimensions of the effect are more pronounced: the Limonene-driven mood elevation and Caryophyllene-driven physical ease are amplified alongside the THC potency. Users typically report happiness, creativity, and social ease alongside a grounding physical comfort that makes GSC suitable for a wide range of contexts — creative work, social settings, and light-to-moderate physical relaxation. faqs.q: What strains were crossed to produce Ice Cream Man?
faqs.a: Ice Cream Man is most commonly attributed to a cross of Jet Fuel Gelato and Legend Orange Apricot. Jet Fuel Gelato brings the Gelato lineage — which traces back through Thin Mint GSC and Sunset Sherbet — alongside the Jet Fuel (G6/Jet Fuel) fuel-forward gas character. Legend Orange Apricot contributes the stone-fruit citrus brightness that creates the fruity, creamy, apricot-like top note that distinguishes Ice Cream Man from plainer Gelato descendants. It is worth noting that multiple breeders have released strains under the Ice Cream Man name with varying lineages — some describe the strain as deriving from Cookies and Gelato family trees more broadly, and phenotypic expression varies between cultivators. The Jet Fuel Gelato × Legend Orange Apricot lineage is the most widely cited and consistent with the aromatic profile that defines the strain's reputation.

faqs.q: How does Ice Cream Man live resin differ from Ice Cream Cake or Ice Cream strain live resins?
faqs.a: Ice Cream Man, Ice Cream Cake, and plain Ice Cream are three different strains that share only the ice cream theme in their naming. Ice Cream Cake is a cross of Wedding Cake and Gelato #33, producing a sweeter, more vanilla-cake aromatic profile. Plain Ice Cream strains vary by breeder but often derive from similar dessert-adjacent cookie genetics. Ice Cream Man comes from Jet Fuel Gelato × Legend Orange Apricot, giving it a distinctly more citrusy-fruity and fuel-forward character than the creamier, cakier profiles of Ice Cream Cake. In live resin form the differences between these strains are most pronounced — the terpene fidelity of fresh-frozen extraction makes the citrus-apricot brightness of Ice Cream Man easily distinguishable from the vanilla-forward sweetness of Ice Cream Cake.

faqs.q: Who created the Triangle Mints strain and what are its parent genetics?
faqs.a: Triangle Mints was bred by Seed Junky Genetics, one of the most respected breeding operations in the modern cannabis industry and creator of several landmark hybrid strains. The cross combines Triangle Kush — a Florida OG heirloom landrace named after the Tampa-Jacksonville-Miami triangle that has long supplied premium cannabis to the East Coast — with Animal Mints, itself a Seed Junky cross of Animal Cookies and SinMint Cookies. Animal Mints carries GSC and Blue Power genetics through SinMint Cookies, which gives Triangle Mints its connection to the cookie family's sweet, dense terpene expression. Triangle Kush anchors the hybrid with its indica-dominant kush structure, earthy fuel character, and the cerebral OG-type high that Triangle Kush is known for producing. Triangle Mints is also known as Octagon Kush.

faqs.q: Why does Triangle Mints live resin emphasise the mint character more than dried Triangle Mints extracts?
faqs.a: The minty, menthol-adjacent aromatic quality of Triangle Mints comes primarily from a combination of terpenes including Limonene and terpinolene-adjacent compounds in the Animal Mints lineage that are particularly volatile — they evaporate and degrade quickly once the plant is harvested and exposed to air, heat, and light during drying and curing. AO Extracts' fresh-frozen live resin approach prevents this degradation by flash-freezing the plant immediately after harvest and maintaining cold temperatures throughout extraction, preserving these volatile aromatics in the final product. This is why Triangle Mints live resin delivers a notably sharper, more pronounced mint-menthol aromatic character than concentrates produced from dried Triangle Mints flower — the extract captures the terpenes as they exist in the living plant rather than the depleted profile of cured material.

faqs.q: How does Triangle Mints live resin compare to other minty cannabis concentrates?
faqs.a: Triangle Mints derives its mint character from the terpene composition of its Animal Mints lineage — it is a natural expression of the plant's genetics rather than added flavouring. Other minty concentrates sometimes use botanical mint terpenes added to distillate to approximate the sensation. In Triangle Mints live resin, the cooling, fresh herbal quality is inseparable from the earthy kush and sweet herb aromatic layers that make up the complete profile — it is a more complex and grounded mint than straight botanical mint terpene additions produce. The Caryophyllene peppery spice and the Myrcene earthiness contextualise the mint within a full aromatic picture, which is what makes Triangle Mints distinctive in the minty cannabis concentrate category.

faqs.q: What makes the 3-gram disposable format distinctive?
faqs.a: A 3-gram THCa disposable is a large-format device — approximately 600–900 puffs depending on draw length compared to 200–300 in a standard 1g disposable. This extended format eliminates frequent device replacement for regular vapers, provides significantly better per-gram value, and ensures the device lasts through an extended period of regular use. For dedicated THCa vape consumers, the 3g format represents the most practical and value-efficient disposable available.

faqs.q: What terpene profile does the Fruit flavour represent?
faqs.a: The Fruit profile in the Asheville Dispensary THCa vape represents a multi-fruit sweet cannabis terpene blend — combining the most appealing fruit-forward cannabis aromatics (tropical, berry, citrus notes) into a broadly appealing sweet-fruity vaping experience. The Fruit category is specifically designed for consumers who prefer sweet, pleasant, accessible cannabis-adjacent aromatic profiles rather than fuel-forward or earthy alternatives.

faqs.q: How does THCa in a disposable vape work?
faqs.a: In a heated vape device, THCa undergoes rapid decarboxylation — converting from non-psychoactive tetrahydrocannabinolic acid to psychoactive THC. This happens in milliseconds during the draw. The resulting vapour contains active THC, producing psychoactive effects equivalent to traditional cannabis vaping. The 3g THCa disposable provides extended psychoactive vaping equivalent to approximately 3g of high-THC cannabis oil.

faqs.q: What makes the original UK Cheese genetic so distinctive?
faqs.a: The Cheese lineage traces back to a specific Skunk #1 phenotype that appeared in the UK underground cannabis scene in the late 1980s, reportedly first grown by the collective known as Exodus. This particular Skunk #1 phenotype expressed an unusually strong cheese-like aroma from a specific combination of terpenes (particularly caryophyllene and ocimene) that distinguished it completely from other Skunk plants. It became the most sought-after cannabis in the UK and spawned the entire UK Cheese cannabis movement — Big Buddha Cheese is one of the most celebrated commercial seed versions of this lineage.

faqs.q: How does Afghani change the Cheese experience?
faqs.a: Pure Cheese strains carry primarily physical relaxation from the Skunk #1 indica base but are not as powerfully sedating as deep indica-dominant genetics. Big Buddha's addition of Afghani amplifies the physical, body-heavy, sedating qualities significantly — the Afghani genetics add muscle relaxation, appetite stimulation, and a more pronounced couch-lock dimension to the Cheese experience. The flavour gains earthy hashish depth from the Afghani, making the aromatic profile more complex than pure Cheese alone.

faqs.q: What flavour and aroma should I expect from Big Buddha Cheese?
faqs.a: Big Buddha Cheese is one of the most aromatically distinctive cannabis strains — the pungent, sharp cheese aroma from the UK Cheese lineage is immediately identifiable and unlike most cannabis varieties. Expect a strong, sharp, aged-cheese pungency with earthy skunk undertones from the Afghani. The flavour is similarly bold — cheesy, spicy, and earthy. This is not a subtle or sweet strain; Big Buddha Cheese's aroma is assertive and unforgettable.

faqs.q: What strains were crossed to produce Black Diamond and why does it have purple colouring?
faqs.a: Black Diamond was bred by crossing Blackberry with Diamond OG, a Diamond-designated OG Kush descendant from Northern California. Blackberry itself is a cross of Afghani and Black Domina, carrying both the sweet berry aromatics and the anthocyanin genetics responsible for the strain's signature purple colouration. Anthocyanins are water-soluble pigments that produce red, purple, and blue colours in plants when exposed to cooler temperatures during the final weeks of the flowering cycle — a phenomenon also seen in other purple cannabis strains like Granddaddy Purple and Blackberry Kush. Black Diamond's Blackberry parent ensures reliable anthocyanin expression, giving the buds and concentrate material their visually distinctive deep purple character that stands out among kush-descended strains.

faqs.q: What does AAA grading mean for the Black Diamond concentrate?
faqs.a: AAA grading in the cannabis concentrate market refers to a premium quality tier above the standard commercial AA grade but below the ultra-premium AAAA craft designation. AAA material indicates carefully selected starting flower with strong terpene expression, clean appearance, good trim quality, and consistent potency — material that meets a higher standard than bulk commercial production but may not carry the hand-crafted, small-batch premium of AAAA craft flower or extract. For Black Diamond AAA concentrate, the grading signals that the source material was evaluated and selected for quality before extraction, which translates to a more aromatic, flavourful, and consistent concentrate than would be produced from lower-grade trim or shake material.

faqs.q: What effects should I expect from Black Diamond AAA and when is it best used?
faqs.a: Black Diamond is an indica-dominant hybrid that typically produces a sequenced effect: an initial euphoric mental lift that the OG Kush lineage drives, followed by a progressive physical relaxation from the indica and Myrcene-forward terpene profile. The THC content of source Black Diamond flower typically ranges from 18 to 24%, and in concentrate form the potency is substantially higher, so the effect onset is rapid and pronounced. Most users find Black Diamond appropriate for late afternoon and evening use — it provides enough mental clarity in the initial phase for relaxed socialising or creative activity but develops into a grounding physical ease that is better suited to rest than to high-output productivity. For pain management, stress, and insomnia, the OG Kush heritage provides the analgesic and anxiolytic properties that made kush-descendant strains the dominant choice in medical cannabis markets.

faqs.q: Is Black Widow appropriate for new cannabis consumers?

New consumers should start with a minimal amount and wait 15+ minutes. Experienced sativa enthusiasts will appreciate Black Widow's intensity and quality.

faqs.a: Blackberry is most commonly attributed to a cross of Black Domina (an ultra-potent pure indica from Afghan, Canadian, Ortega, and Hash Plant genetics) and a berry-expressing sativa such as Raspberry Cough or similar fruity genetics. The Black Domina component provides the deep, heavy indica body effects and dark bud coloration, while the berry genetics contribute the authentic dark berry aroma and some mood-lifting dimension to what would otherwise be a purely sedating indica.

faqs.q: Why do Blackberry buds develop purple hues?
faqs.a: Blackberry's dark purple and near-black bud colouration comes from high anthocyanin expression — water-soluble pigment compounds in the cannabis plant that produce red, purple, and blue colours. Anthocyanin expression is triggered by temperature fluctuations during the late flowering stage (cooler night temperatures), and strains with Black Domina or other dark-pigmented genetics in their lineage are particularly prone to developing striking purple-to-black bud colouration. At AAA quality, this visual appeal is well-expressed.

faqs.q: What are Blackberry AAA's medical applications?

faqs.q: What makes 'Blonde' hash different from darker hash grades?
faqs.a: Hash colour reflects oxidation and processing — blonde (light golden to amber) hash is the least oxidised, indicating fresher, more carefully processed resin with better terpene and cannabinoid preservation. Darker hash (brown, black) has undergone more processing, oxidation, or aging, which reduces terpene content and can affect potency. Blonde Butterscotch Hash represents the premium end of traditional pressed hash — fresh resin carefully pressed at lower temperatures to maintain the sweet butterscotch aromatic character.

faqs.q: What strain produces the Butterscotch aromatic character in this hash?
faqs.a: Butterscotch-scented cannabis hash typically derives from strains with vanilla-caramel-sweet terpene profiles — possibly Mendo Breath, OG Kush Breath, or Butterscotch-adjacent genetics that produce the characteristic caramel-vanilla terpene expression when processed into hash. The blonde colour preservation ensures these delicate sweet-caramel terpenes are maintained at their best intensity in the final product.

faqs.q: How is Blonde Butterscotch Hash best consumed?
faqs.a: Traditional pressed hash like Blonde Butterscotch Hash can be consumed in multiple ways: crumbled into flower bowls for a combined experience; smoked directly in a pipe or chillum; hot-knifed using heated metal; or vaporised in a dab rig or vaporiser designed for concentrates. The sweet butterscotch aromatic character is best appreciated when vaporised at lower temperatures that preserve the delicate caramel-vanilla terpene notes.

faqs.q: Do Blue Vibe CBD Gummies produce any psychoactive or intoxicating effect?
faqs.a: No — Blue Vibe CBD Gummies contain hemp-derived CBD (cannabidiol) as the primary active cannabinoid. CBD is non-psychoactive: it does not bind to CB1 receptors in the brain with the affinity that THC does and does not produce euphoria, altered perception, impairment, or the 'high' associated with cannabis use. At the trace THC levels present in full-spectrum hemp extracts (below 0.3%), no psychoactive effect occurs. CBD's effects are described as subtle and functional — reduced stress, improved calmness, better sleep quality, and physical ease — rather than the distinctly perceptible psychoactive experience of THC products. Consumers who have accidentally taken too much and experienced unwanted effects were most likely using THC-containing products, not CBD-only products like Blue Vibe.

faqs.q: Can Blue Vibe CBD Gummies cause a positive drug test?
faqs.a: CBD itself is not detected by standard drug tests, which screen for THC metabolites rather than CBD. However, full-spectrum CBD products can contain trace amounts of THC (below 0.3% by law) that may, with regular use at significant doses, accumulate and potentially trigger a positive drug screen in some sensitive tests. For consumers subject to drug testing, CBD isolate products (containing only CBD with no other cannabinoids or traceable THC) are safer than full-spectrum or broad-spectrum products. If the Blue Vibe CBD Gummies use CBD isolate rather than full-spectrum extract, the drug test risk is minimal to none. Always check the product's Certificate of Analysis for total cannabinoid content if drug testing is a concern.

faqs.q: How many Blue Vibe CBD Gummies should I take and when?
faqs.a: Appropriate CBD gummy dosing depends on the per-piece CBD milligram content (check the packaging), your body weight, individual endocannabinoid system responsiveness, and the specific therapeutic goal. General starting guidance for new CBD users is one gummy per serving and assessing after 60 to 90 minutes — CBD edibles follow the same delayed oral absorption pathway as THC edibles, though the effects are less dramatically obvious. For sleep support, take 30 to 60 minutes before bed. For daytime stress management, take with or after a meal in the morning. CBD's effects are cumulative — consistent daily use typically produces more consistent results than occasional use. Start low, be patient with the 60–90 minute onset window, and adjust dose incrementally over several days rather than increasing within a single session.

AAAA+ is where Blueberry OG's potential is fully realised.

faqs.q: Why is DJ Short's Blueberry considered a landmark cannabis strain?
faqs.a: DJ Short spent decades in the 1970s through 1990s experimenting with Thai, Afghan, and other landrace strains to produce cannabis with authentic fruit flavours — before this was common. Blueberry emerged as his greatest achievement: an indica with genuine, recognisable blueberry sweetness from a precise terpene combination (myrcene, ocimene, and others) rather than artificial flavouring. The 2000 High Times Cannabis Cup victory for Best Indica confirmed what the cannabis community already knew — Blueberry's flavour-focused breeding had produced something genuinely exceptional.

faqs.q: What is Blueberry's genetic background?

The strain has spawned hundreds of descendants — Blue Dream, Blue Cheese, Blueberry Kush, Berry White, Blue Haze — that share the authentic blueberry terpene character.

faqs.q: When is Blueberry best consumed?
faqs.a: Blueberry's 80% indica character makes it an evening and nighttime strain. faqs.q: What is bubble hash and how does it differ from other cannabis concentrates?
faqs.a: Bubble hash is produced without chemical solvents — cold water and ice mechanically separate trichome heads from the cannabis plant, which are then collected through mesh bags of varying micron sizes (each size capturing different trichome head sizes) and dried. Unlike BHO (butane hash oil), rosin, or CO2 extracts, bubble hash involves only water and mechanical separation. This produces a concentrate that is free from solvent residue, preserving the full natural terpene and cannabinoid profile of the source material.

faqs.q: What is the 'bubble test' for hash quality?
faqs.a: Traditionally, hash quality was assessed by heating a small piece — high-quality hash (full-melt or near-full-melt) bubbles and melts when a flame is applied, indicating high trichome-head content with minimal plant material contamination. Hash that burns without bubbling has more plant matter. Bubble hash (named for this test) represents the category where the extraction quality is high enough to reliably pass the bubble melt test.

faqs.q: How is bubble hash best consumed?
faqs.a: Bubble hash can be consumed multiple ways depending on its melt quality: full-melt bubble hash can be dabbed directly in a dab rig or vaporiser; partial-melt hash is best crumbled into flower bowls or sprinkled on top of joints; all bubble hash can be pressed with heat and pressure into rosin. Vaporisation at lower temperatures (below 220°C) best preserves the terpene character and provides the most complete flavour experience.

faqs.q: What makes Buddies cannabis-derived terpenes different from botanical terpenes in vape cartridges?
faqs.a: Cannabis-derived terpenes (CDT) are extracted directly from cannabis or hemp plants and contain the exact same aromatic compounds found in the cannabis strain they came from — including not just the primary terpenes like myrcene and limonene, but also the trace and minor terpenes that together create the complete aromatic fingerprint of a specific cultivar. Botanical terpenes, by contrast, are sourced from non-cannabis plants (lemon for limonene, black pepper for caryophyllene, etc.) and then blended to approximate a cannabis strain's profile. The difference in practice is that CDT cartridges taste more genuinely like the cannabis strain they represent — with the complexity and depth that single-source cannabis terpene extraction preserves — while botanical terpene blends often taste flatter or generic compared to the real thing. Buddies' patented CDT reintroduction process is specifically designed to capture and restore this authentic strain character.

faqs.q: What is Marionberry Kush and what should I expect from the flavour?
faqs.a: Marionberry Kush is a hybrid strain bred by Heroes of the Farm, named after the marionberry — a cultivar of blackberry developed at Oregon State University and now associated with the Pacific Northwest. The strain is a cross of Raspberry Kush and Space Queen, both of which contribute fruit-forward sweetness: Raspberry Kush with its sweet berry body and indica relaxation, Space Queen with its complex sweet fruit and sativa-influenced cerebral component. The flavour profile of Marionberry Kush is sweet berry — reminiscent of the dark berries it is named for — with earthy kush undertones and a slightly sour fruity finish. In the Buddies CDT cartridge, this profile is preserved through cannabis-derived terpenes rather than synthetic berry flavouring, which means the berry character reads as genuine fruit rather than candy-like artificiality.

faqs.q: How should I store and use the Buddies Marionberry Kush Distillate cartridge?
faqs.a: Store the Buddies Marionberry Kush Distillate cartridge upright and at room temperature — avoid heat above 25°C (77°F) and direct sunlight, both of which can cause the distillate oil to thin and leak around the mouthpiece seal. The 510-thread design is compatible with standard variable-voltage vape batteries; starting at a lower voltage setting (around 2.4 to 3.0V) will preserve more of the CDT terpene character and produce a smoother, more flavourful draw, while higher voltage settings produce larger vapour clouds but may burn off some of the volatile terpene aromatics. Allow the cartridge to warm for a moment before drawing if stored cold, as distillate can become more viscous at cooler temperatures and may produce a restricted draw directly from refrigerator temperature.

Live resin (like the Buddies Runtz and Bacio Pancakes) preserves the full terpene spectrum; distillate (like Vulcan Fuel) prioritises potency and consistency over aromatic complexity.
