faqs.a: Pink Runtz is a phenotype selection within the Zkittlez × Gelato Runtz family that specifically emphasises: pink-purple bud colouration from anthocyanin expression; a particularly sweet, candy-pink aromatic profile; and a slightly more balanced or sativa-leaning effect compared to the more heavily indica Black Runtz. Standard Runtz is balanced; Black Runtz is indica-dominant; Pink Runtz occupies a sweeter, more candy-forward position in the family's effect and aromatic spectrum.

faqs.q: What produces Pink Runtz's distinctive pink colouration?
faqs.a: Pink Runtz's pink-to-purple bud colouration comes from anthocyanin pigment expression — the same genetic mechanism that produces purple in other cannabis varieties, but in Pink Runtz expressed in warmer pink-to-rose-to-lavender hues rather than deep purple or blue. faqs.a: Pinkman Goo produces visible, sticky amber or clear resin droplets (goo) on the surface of the flowers — essentially the plant's trichome glands producing so much resin that liquid beads form on the bud exterior. This is a rare and genetically unusual trait in cannabis that signals exceptionally high resin production — the trichome glands are producing cannabinoid-rich resin faster than they can hold it. The phenomenon is both visually distinctive and a quality indicator for high cannabinoid content.

faqs.q: What is live rosin and how does it differ from distillate in gummies?
faqs.a: Live rosin is produced by flash-freezing freshly harvested hemp immediately after harvest to preserve peak terpene and cannabinoid content, then pressing the frozen flower under controlled heat and pressure to extract a solventless concentrate. No chemical solvents (butane, CO2, ethanol) are involved at any stage. Distillate-based gummies use chemically processed extract that removes most terpenes and minor cannabinoids, then may add artificial terpenes back. Live rosin gummies retain the authentic full-spectrum plant character — richer flavour, more complex effect, and a purer eating experience than distillate alternatives.

faqs.q: Why are Pure Roots Botanicals gummies particularly notable for organic quality?
faqs.a: Pure Roots Botanicals holds USDA Certified Organic and CCOF certification — among the highest agricultural standards available in the US — and critically, they grow their hemp, press their own rosin, and make their own gummies in-house. Most hemp brands source cannabinoids from third-party suppliers with unknown farming practices. Pure Roots' vertical integration means their organic certification covers the entire supply chain, not just part of it.

faqs.q: What does 'Indica-dominant' mean for a 20mg live rosin gummy experience?
faqs.a: Indica-dominant live rosin gummies are formulated with indica-strain hemp cultivars whose terpene profiles (myrcene-forward, caryophyllene-rich) direct the D9 experience toward physical relaxation, body ease, and calming mental effect rather than energising cerebral sativa character. At 20mg D9 with full-spectrum live rosin terpenes, the indica positioning produces a notably relaxing, physically soothing effect appropriate for evening use, muscle recovery, and stress relief.

faqs.q: Why does Pure Roots use the ice water extraction method for their live rosin?

The collected trichomes (bubble hash) are then pressed under low heat and pressure to produce live rosin. This double-step solventless process produces the purest possible cannabis concentrate, retaining the full terpene profile and avoiding any residual chemical contamination that solvent-based methods risk even after post-processing purging.

faqs.q: What are Hindu Kush and Purple Afghani and how do they combine?
faqs.a: Hindu Kush is the pure Afghan-Pakistani indica landrace — one of the most potent, sedating, and resinous cannabis varieties on earth, used for hash production for centuries. Purple Afghani is an Afghan landrace phenotype selected for deep purple colouration and grape-berry aromatic expression. Together they create Purple Kush: the deeply sedating, physically numbing effects of Hindu Kush with the beautiful purple colouration and sweet-grape aromatic character of Purple Afghani — the definitive purple indica experience.

faqs.q: Why is Purple Kush so associated with California cannabis culture?
faqs.a: Purple Kush has strong roots in Oakland, California, where the 'Oakland Purple' strain emerged as one of the first widely distributed quality purple cannabis varieties in the US market. It became a staple of California's pre-legalisation cannabis scene and remained a consistent best-seller through legalisation. Purple Kush's visual appeal (deep purple buds), pleasant aroma, and reliable heavy indica effects made it a gateway strain for many California cannabis consumers.

faqs.q: Is Purple Kush appropriate for severe pain management?
faqs.a: Yes — Purple Kush's pure indica Hindu Kush genetics make it one of the most effective strains for chronic pain. The Hindu Kush provides comprehensive CB1-mediated analgesia alongside the physical body-numbing sedation. Medical cannabis patients consistently rate Purple Kush as one of their most effective pain management strains, particularly for musculoskeletal pain, neuropathic pain, and inflammatory conditions.

faqs.q: What do Larry OG and Granddaddy Purple contribute to Purple Punch?
faqs.a: Larry OG (OG Kush phenotype) contributes lemon-citrus-pine OG complexity, reliable potency, and the structural genetics that give Purple Punch its dense, well-formed bud structure. Granddaddy Purple (Purple Urkle × Big Bud) contributes the signature deep grape-berry-sweet aromatic character, deep purple colouration from anthocyanins, and the heavy sedating body effects. The combination produces Purple Punch's unique sweet-berry-OG-lemon layering and potent indica sedation.

faqs.q: Why is Purple Punch a popular genetic base for other strains?
faqs.a: Purple Punch has become one of the most-used parent strains in modern breeding because its grape-berry-sweet aromatic profile, purple colouration genetics, and reliable indica effects translate excellently to crosses. Strains like Mimosa (Clementine × Purple Punch), Banana Punch (Banana OG × Purple Punch), Cherry Punch, and dozens of others use Purple Punch to add visual appeal, dessert sweetness, and reliable indica body effects to whatever they are crossed with.

faqs.q: Is Purple Punch appropriate for sleep disorders?
faqs.a: Yes — Purple Punch is consistently recommended for insomnia and sleep disorders. The Larry OG-derived OG Kush sedation combined with Granddaddy Purple's legendary sleep-promoting character creates one of the most reliable and pleasant sleep-induction strains available. The sweet-berry aromatic character also makes evening consumption particularly enjoyable as part of a sleep preparation routine.

faqs.q: What do the Purple Afghani genetics add to Girl Scout Cookies?
faqs.a: Purple Afghani is a landrace-derived indica strain known for producing purple-tinged flowers (from high anthocyanin content), deeply relaxing body effects, earthy-berry aromatic character, and potent THC expression. faqs.q: Why is 'Space' in the Purple Space Cookies name?
faqs.a: The 'Space' in Purple Space Cookies refers to the strain's potently sedating, deeply relaxing effect — the sensation of being so physically eased and mentally floated that the consumer feels removed from normal cognitive engagement, in a pleasant 'spaced out' state. The name captures the combined effect of the Purple Afghani's heavy indica sedation and GSC's euphoric mental uplift — you're blissfully uplifted but also deeply physically settled, creating that distinctive floaty, spacey quality.

faqs.q: What time of day is Purple Space Cookies best for?
faqs.a: Purple Space Cookies is strictly an evening and nighttime strain. The indica-dominant genetics produce progressive physical sedation and couch-lock that builds as the session continues, eventually leading to deep relaxation and sleep. The initial GSC-sourced mood uplift makes the onset pleasant, but the Purple Afghani's body weight settles in reliably within 30–60 minutes. Best consumed 1–2 hours before intended sleep, for chronic pain management at day's end, or for deep relaxation sessions with no obligations.

faqs.q: What makes Purple Urkle's grape-sweet aroma so distinctive?
faqs.a: Purple Urkle's aromatic profile is considered unusually authentic in its grape-tropical sweetness — not just generally 'sweet' but specifically and recognisably grape-candy-tropical in a way that most purple strains don't achieve as consistently. This comes from a specific terpene combination (high ocimene and myrcene alongside fruity esters) in the original Mendocino County phenotype that produces the characteristic grape-berry-tropical-skunk layering. Purple Urkle's aromatic precision is why it became a highly sought-after parent strain.

faqs.q: How did Purple Urkle become so foundationally important in cannabis genetics?
faqs.a: Ken Estes chose Purple Urkle as one of the two parents (with Big Bud) when creating Granddaddy Purple in 2003 — and GDP became one of the most iconic American indica strains. Purple Urkle was also chosen as a parent for Cadillac Purple (with Bubba Kush and Blackberry Kush) alongside its own standalone reputation. Its genetic contribution to these landmark strains, combined with its own exceptional quality, established Purple Urkle as a foundational Californian indica genetic.

faqs.q: Is Purple Urkle appropriate for medical cannabis patients?
faqs.a: Yes — Purple Urkle's heavy indica genetics make it excellent for medical applications requiring significant physical sedation and comfort: chronic pain, severe insomnia, extreme muscle tension, and PTSD where deep physical and mental calming is therapeutic. The sweet-grape aromatic character makes consumption pleasant even for medical patients who approach cannabis pragmatically.

faqs.a: Mood's standard Rapid Onset D9 gummies use nano D9 alone for quick-onset cannabis effects at a moderate dose — appropriate for a broad range of consumers from casual to experienced. The result is substantially faster onset — 5–15 minutes versus 45–90 — while retaining the longer-lasting 4–8 hour duration of oral edibles.

faqs.q: Why are albino mushrooms typically more potent?
faqs.a: Albino Psilocybe cubensis variants lack melanin pigment production — the metabolic resources that would normally go toward pigment synthesis are redirected toward psilocybin and other alkaloid production. This metabolic shift is associated with higher psilocybin and psilocin content per gram of dry mushroom compared to pigmented variants from the same genetic base. The 'White' designation in Rustic White Albino directly references this potency-correlated albino characteristic.

faqs.q: What is 'Rustic' about the Rustic White Albino presentation?
faqs.a: The 'Rustic' descriptor indicates a natural, unrefined aesthetic quality — the fruiting bodies have a naturally rustic, earthy, unpretentious appearance rather than the pristine, uniform look of more commercialised strains. Rustic White Albino embraces the natural variation in fruiting body shape and size that occurs in authentic cubensis cultivation, presenting a natural and genuine product rather than perfectly uniform commercial specimens.

faqs.q: What experience does Rustic White Albino produce?
faqs.a: As an albino-variant cubensis, Rustic White Albino delivers above-average potency psilocybin experience — meaningful visuals, body euphoria, emotional opening, and introspective depth at doses lower than required for average strains. The experience profile is complete and profound — appropriate for experienced users who want quality above-average potency in a naturally presented mushroom.

faqs.q: What is Secret OG CBD's genetic background and how does it relate to OG Kush?
faqs.a: Secret OG CBD was bred in-house by Secret Nature through selective crosses between OG Kush genetics and CBD-rich hemp cultivars, choosing phenotypes that maximise CBD expression while preserving the terpene profile, bud structure, and aromatic character that define authentic OG Kush. OG Kush emerged in California in the early 1990s, most commonly attributed to a cross of Chemdawg with a Hindu Kush landrace, and is characterised by its diesel-and-lemon aroma, dense resinous buds, and heavy indica relaxation. Secret OG's breeding goal was specifically to create a CBD strain that a knowledgeable cannabis consumer would recognise as OG lineage on sight, smell, and effect — Secret Nature reports that customers frequently describe Secret OG as almost identical to OG Kush in appearance, aroma, and taste.

faqs.q: How does Secret OG CBD compare to Secret Nature's Frosted Kush strain?
faqs.a: Secret OG CBD and Frosted Kush are both Secret Nature OG Kush-lineage CBD strains with indica-dominant profiles suited to evening and rest use. The primary differences are in aroma character and specific terpene expression. Secret OG leads with Caryophyllene and has a more pronounced gassy, diesel, and cream character — described as gassy lemons and earth — that reflects a bolder OG Kush phenotype. Frosted Kush has a more pine-forward, earthy aroma with subtle citrus from its Myrcene and Limonene-led profile, and is noted for looking extraordinarily frosted due to its trichome density. Both produce deep indica relaxation through their CBD content and myrcene-heavy terpene expression. Secret OG is the choice for consumers who want the unmistakable OG diesel character; Frosted Kush suits those who prefer a cleaner pine and earth profile.

faqs.q: Is Secret OG CBD only for experienced CBD flower consumers?
faqs.a: Secret OG CBD is appropriate for CBD flower consumers at any experience level who want an evening and rest-oriented strain. Since it contains less than 0.3% Delta 9 THC, there is no psychoactive impairment regardless of quantity used — the experience is non-intoxicating. New CBD flower consumers should be aware that Secret OG's indica-dominant profile and myrcene-heavy terpene expression produce meaningful physical relaxation and sleepiness, even without THC, which makes it unsuitable for daytime use even for CBD beginners. The OG lineage gives Secret OG a strong aroma profile that experienced cannabis consumers will recognise and appreciate, but the therapeutic CBD delivery is equally accessible to consumers who have never smoked cannabis flower before. Evening use, comfortable setting, and the expectation of significant relaxation are the appropriate context for this strain at any experience level.

faqs.q: Can I take Sleepytime gummies alongside other sleep aids?

faqs.q: Why does Snapdragon use sea buckthorn oil in the CBD CBG Lip Balm?
faqs.a: Sea buckthorn oil is one of the most nutritionally dense plant oils available for topical skin care — it is exceptionally rich in omega-3, omega-6, omega-7, and omega-9 fatty acids, carotenoids, and vitamins C and E. The omega-7 fatty acids found in sea buckthorn (primarily palmitoleic acid) are particularly rare in plant oils and have documented associations with supporting mucous membrane health and skin regeneration — making them especially relevant for the delicate and often stressed skin of the lips. In Snapdragon CBD CBG Lip Balm Blueberry, the sea buckthorn contributes a protective and regenerative skin care quality that standard lip balm bases like petroleum or plain beeswax do not provide. The orange-tinted oil also adds natural carotenoid antioxidants that complement the anti-inflammatory properties of the CBD and CBG.

faqs.q: What does CBG add to a lip balm that CBD alone doesn't provide?
faqs.a: CBG (cannabigerol) adds documented antibacterial properties to the lip balm formula that CBD does not reliably provide on its own. Research has identified CBG as having meaningful activity against certain bacteria including Staphylococcus aureus strains, which are a common cause of secondary infections in damaged skin including cracked or chapped lips. CBD's primary contribution to the lip balm is anti-inflammatory — it reduces redness, swelling, and irritation. The CBG's antibacterial activity provides a separate layer of protection against infection of compromised lip skin, which is why the combination of 10mg CBD and 5mg CBG creates a more complete topical lip care formula than either cannabinoid alone at equivalent total milligrams.

faqs.q: How does Snapdragon CBD CBG Lip Balm Blueberry compare to regular non-cannabinoid lip balms?
faqs.a: Standard lip balms — whether petroleum-based, beeswax-based, or plant wax-based — provide occlusive moisture retention and physical protection but do not engage the skin's endocannabinoid receptors. Snapdragon CBD CBG Lip Balm Blueberry does both: the rice bran wax, shea butter, and olive oil base provides the same physical moisturising and protective function as a standard balm, while the CBD and CBG engage local CB2 receptors in lip skin tissue to actively reduce inflammation and provide antibacterial support. Consumers who find standard lip balms adequate for normal hydration but insufficient for inflamed, chronically chapped, or irritation-prone lips typically find the cannabinoid addition makes a meaningful functional difference. The absence of any cannabis flavour due to pure extract means the user experience is identical to a standard flavoured lip balm.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Snapdragon X-Freeze as a transdermal product and a regular CBD topical?
faqs.a: Standard CBD topicals — creams, salves, balms — are absorbed into the outermost layers of the skin and underlying tissue at the application site, engaging local cannabinoid receptors but not significantly penetrating into the bloodstream. Snapdragon Pain Relief X-Freeze Roll On is formulated as a transdermal product, meaning it is designed to penetrate the skin's protective outer barrier (the stratum corneum) and deliver cannabinoids into the bloodstream through the skin at the application site. The Nano-Sonic nano-emulsification process breaks the CBD and CBG into smaller particles specifically to improve this skin-barrier penetration. The practical difference is that a transdermal product can provide both targeted local relief and some systemic cannabinoid effect from the same application, which a standard topical cannot.

faqs.q: What does Nano-Sonic CBD and CBG mean in the Snapdragon X-Freeze formula?
faqs.a: Nano-Sonic is Snapdragon Hemp's proprietary term for their nano-emulsification process, which reduces CBD and CBG molecules into nano-scale droplets through sonication (sound wave energy application). Standard cannabinoid oils have large molecule clusters that the skin's barrier effectively blocks from deep penetration. Nano-emulsified cannabinoids with dramatically smaller particle sizes can navigate through the tight junctions of the skin barrier more efficiently, improving both the speed and depth of penetration. In the X-Freeze formula, 1,000mg of Nano-Sonic CBD and 500mg of Nano-Sonic CBG are used specifically because the enhanced bioavailability of the nano-processed cannabinoids is what enables the transdermal delivery profile that distinguishes this product from standard topicals.

faqs.q: How should I apply the Snapdragon X-Freeze Roll On for best results?
faqs.a: Apply Snapdragon Pain Relief X-Freeze Roll On directly to clean, dry skin over the painful area — muscle belly for muscular pain, joint area for articular pain, or along a tendon or nerve pathway for neuropathic discomfort. Roll on a thin, even layer and allow it to absorb without rubbing in — the transdermal formulation is designed to penetrate through absorption contact rather than through massage friction. Avoid washing the application area for at least 30 to 60 minutes after applying to allow sufficient transdermal absorption time. The cooling effect should be felt immediately on application. For chronic conditions, apply two to three times daily to the affected area and expect cumulative benefit with consistent use over several days, as transdermal cannabinoid levels in the local tissue build over time.

faqs.q: What makes Sour Diesel one of the most iconic cannabis strains?
faqs.a: Sour Diesel (Sour D) emerged on the East Coast US cannabis scene in the early 1990s and became a defining sativa strain of the modern cannabis era. Its extremely pungent diesel-fuel-and-citrus aroma is unmistakable — unlike any other strain — and its effects are fast-acting, powerfully cerebral, and energising without the sedation of indica strains. Sour Diesel became the reference strain for daytime sativa use and remains one of the most requested strains at dispensaries worldwide decades after its introduction.

faqs.q: How does Delta-8 change the Sour Diesel experience compared to Delta-9?
faqs.a: Delta-8 is approximately 50–66% as potent as Delta-9 at CB1 receptors and produces a smoother, clearer-headed experience with significantly less anxiety potential than D9 at equivalent doses. In a Sour Diesel context, this means the strain's signature cerebral sativa energy is present but gentler and less risk of the anxiety or paranoia that some consumers experience from high-D9 Sour Diesel. D8 Sour Diesel delivers the creative, uplifting, energising character of the strain in a more accessible, lower-anxiety format.

faqs.q: Is Sour Diesel Delta 8 appropriate for daytime use?

Avoid before sleep as the sativa stimulation will prevent easy sleep onset for most consumers.

faqs.q: Why is Sour Diesel considered an East Coast cannabis icon?
faqs.a: Sour Diesel emerged in the New York cannabis scene in the early 1990s — believed to originate from a Chemdawg 91 cut that was accidentally crossed with Massachusetts Super Skunk (a Skunk #1 derivative). Its distinctive diesel-fuel pungency and fast-hitting cerebral sativa effects stood apart from the predominantly indica cannabis of the era. NYC's cannabis culture adopted Sour Diesel as its defining strain, and its reputation spread nationally through the 1990s and 2000s to become one of the most widely recognised cannabis varieties globally.

faqs.q: What creates Sour Diesel's distinctive diesel-fuel aroma?
faqs.a: Sour Diesel's pungent fuel-chemical aroma comes from an unusually high terpinolene content combined with specific ratios of myrcene, limonene, and caryophyllene that create the diesel-fuel olfactory impression. The Chemdawg parent's chemical-diesel heritage dominates, producing a terpene profile that is immediately and aggressively recognisable as 'diesel.' Consumers consistently describe the aroma as simultaneously repellent and fascinating — the kind of pungency that cannabis enthusiasts love but non-consumers find challenging.

faqs.q: Is Sour Diesel appropriate for depression and energy?
faqs.a: Yes — Sour Diesel is one of the most consistently recommended sativa strains for depression and fatigue management. The fast-acting cerebral uplift and mood elevation are significant and reliable, and the long-lasting energising effects support productive daytime function. Medical cannabis patients with depression consistently rate Sour Diesel among their most effective therapeutic sativa strains for mood and energy restoration.

faqs.q: What makes Strawberry Moonrocks different from regular moonrocks?
faqs.a: Strawberry Moonrocks differ from standard moonrocks primarily in aromatic and flavour character — the 'strawberry' element introduces a sweet, fruity berry dimension to what is otherwise the same three-layer construction of flower, concentrate oil, and kief. In standard moonrocks the flavour is primarily determined by whatever base strain is used; in Strawberry Moonrocks, a strawberry-forward strain, strawberry-terpene-infused oil, or both contribute a distinctive sweet berry aromatic that differs from the earthier, gassier, or more neutral profiles of typical moonrocks. Potency is equivalent to standard moonrocks at 40–60%+ THCa. The strawberry variant appeals specifically to consumers who want the extreme potency of moonrocks with a fruit-sweet aroma rather than the more common earthy or gas-forward profiles.

faqs.q: Are Strawberry Moonrocks appropriate for beginning or moderate cannabis consumers?
faqs.a: No — Strawberry Moonrocks, like all moonrocks, are strictly for experienced cannabis consumers with established tolerance. The three-layer construction typically produces 40–60%+ THCa total, which is two to three times the potency of premium cannabis flower. The sweet strawberry aroma and appealing appearance can make them seem more approachable than gas-forward moonrocks, but the potency level is identical regardless of flavour profile. Consumers who regularly use standard cannabis flower and are curious about moonrocks should start with a single small hit from a glass bowl and wait 15 to 20 minutes to assess the full effect before consuming more. The strawberry character makes the sensory experience pleasant, but it does not reduce the substantial potency.

faqs.q: What is the best way to consume Strawberry Moonrocks?
faqs.a: Break Strawberry Moonrocks into small pieces by hand — never use a herb grinder, as the mechanical action strips the kief coating that represents a significant portion of the product's potency and the oily surface will gum up grinder teeth. Place broken pieces in a glass bowl or pipe; the glass prevents the terpene-rich oil from absorbing into rolling papers as it would with a joint, which wastes both product and potency. Take slow, gentle draws to avoid combusting all three layers simultaneously — the kief, oil, and flower have different burning profiles and slow draws allow them to engage more evenly. The moonrocks will self-extinguish between draws; relight as needed. One small bowl-packing is typically more than sufficient for an extended session given the potency level.

faqs.q: Why did Super Silver Haze win the Cannabis Cup three consecutive years?
faqs.a: Greenhouse Seeds bred SSH by combining three foundational cannabis genetics: Skunk #1 (reliable structure and potency), Northern Lights (trichome density and resin production), and Haze (sativa cerebral effects, complex aromatic depth, and the foundational 'Haze' character). The combination produced a strain with Haze's sought-after cerebral sativa effects in a more cultivatable package (Skunk #1's yield and NL's resin) than original Haze. Three consecutive Cup wins confirmed SSH as the standard-bearer for sativa quality in the late 1990s.

faqs.q: How does Super Silver Haze's effect differ from original Haze?
faqs.a: Original Haze is a pure sativa with extremely long flowering time (14-16+ weeks), modest yields, and intensely psychedelic, almost anxiogenic effects. SSH moderates Haze's intensity with Skunk #1 and Northern Lights genetics — producing the celebrated Haze cerebral uplift and aromatic complexity in a shorter-flowering, higher-yielding, and more effect-accessible package. SSH's Haze effects are still strongly sativa but without the raw intensity that makes original Haze challenging for most consumers.

faqs.q: Is Super Silver Haze appropriate for creative work?
faqs.a: Yes — SSH is considered one of the finest cannabis strains for creative work, artistic projects, and focused intellectual activity. The long-lasting cerebral uplift and mood elevation support sustained creative engagement, while the gentle Skunk/NL body ease prevents anxiety. Many artists, musicians, and writers specifically seek SSH for its sustained creative-enhancement properties.

faqs.q: What is the relationship between Sweet Cake CBD and Wedding Cake?
faqs.a: Sweet Cake CBD was bred by Secret Nature using Wedding Cake genetics as the starting point — also known as Birthday Cake Kush — crossed with CBD-rich hemp cultivars to shift the cannabinoid expression from THC to CBD while preserving the characteristic dessert terpene profile. Wedding Cake itself is a cross of Triangle Kush and Animal Mints through Seed Junky Genetics, carrying lineage from Girl Scout Cookies through the Animal Mints side. The result is that Sweet Cake inherits the vanilla-cream-bakery aroma, the earthy spice undertone, and the indica-dominant relaxation character that define the Wedding Cake family, expressed in a flower that contains over 19% CBD and under 0.3% THC. It is one of the more faithful CBD translations of a premium THC strain genetics.

faqs.q: Why does Secret Nature cold-cure Sweet Cake CBD specifically?
faqs.a: Secret Nature cold-cures Sweet Cake at low temperatures for extended periods because the delicate terpene compounds responsible for the strain's dessert aromatic character — particularly the vanilla and cream notes from Myrcene and the fruity layers from Limonene — are volatile and degrade quickly when exposed to heat. Standard curing at room temperature causes these terpenes to evaporate faster, resulting in a flatter, more generic hemp flavour rather than the authentic bakery-dough and sweet cream character that defines Sweet Cake. Cold curing slows terpene oxidation and evaporation, preserving the nuanced aromatic layers that make Sweet Cake worth choosing over a plain high-CBD strain. The indoor cultivation and cold cure together are what allow the product to deliver on its name consistently.

faqs.q: How does Sweet Cake CBD compare to Frosted Kush and Secret OG as evening strains?
faqs.a: All three Secret Nature indica CBD strains — Sweet Cake, Frosted Kush, and Secret OG — produce significant evening relaxation through their indica genetics and myrcene-forward terpene profiles, but they differ in aroma character and terpene emphasis. Sweet Cake leads with vanilla, cream, and bakery-dough sweetness from the Wedding Cake lineage — a dessert experience. Frosted Kush has a more earthy pine and frosting aroma from its OG Kush genetics — clean and classic kush. Secret OG is the gassiest of the three with a pronounced diesel and lemon fuel character from its deeper OG lineage — the most pungent and terpene-forward option. For consumers who prefer their evening CBD flower to smell like dessert, Sweet Cake is the natural fit. For those who prefer classic kush, Frosted Kush or Secret OG will suit better.

faqs.q: Why did Sweet Tooth win the 2001 Cannabis Cup?

Sweet Tooth is ideal for new cannabis consumers, low-tolerance users, and experienced consumers who want a gentle everyday indica for social and leisure use.

faqs.q: What does Sweet Tooth taste like?

The Afghan component adds mild earthiness that prevents the sweetness from being one-dimensional. Many consumers describe it as tasting like cotton candy or sweet tropical fruit — more candy-sweet than most cannabis strains achieve.

faqs.q: What is THCP and why is it so potent?
faqs.a: THCP (tetrahydrocannabiphorol) was discovered by Italian researchers in 2019. Its 7-carbon alkyl chain (versus THC's 5-carbon chain) allows significantly higher binding affinity to CB1 receptors — estimated at 30x that of delta-9 THC. Even at very small doses, THCP produces substantially more intense psychoactive effects than equivalent THC quantities. This 2g THCP disposable requires extreme dosing conservatism — 1 puff maximum for initial use, with a 30+ minute wait before assessing.

faqs.q: Who is this THCP disposable appropriate for?
faqs.a: THCP disposables are appropriate exclusively for: very experienced cannabis consumers with high THC tolerance who find standard Delta-9 THC products insufficient; those who specifically seek the most intense hemp-derived cannabinoid experience available; and those who have prior experience with potent minor cannabinoid blends. Not appropriate for newcomers, occasional consumers, or those with anxiety concerns.

faqs.q: How does a 2g THCP disposable provide value despite the extreme potency?
faqs.a: At 30x THC potency, effective THCP doses are very small — 1-3 puffs maximum per session for most experienced consumers. A 2g THCP device at these ultra-conservative doses could provide 100-300+ meaningful sessions, making the 2g extended format provide exceptional longevity even for regular users of this extreme-potency cannabinoid.

faqs.q: Are these THCa Diamonds different from the PharmaTHC brand diamonds in the catalogue?
faqs.a: The THCa Diamonds 1g and PharmaTHC THCa Diamonds are the same concentrate format — pure crystallised THCa — but may differ in brand, specific extraction source, and batch-level testing details. PharmaTHC is a CannaBuddy-affiliated brand with published COAs at pharmacbd.com; the THCa Diamonds 1g listing may refer to unbranded diamonds or diamonds from a different producer. In terms of format and function they are equivalent: near-pure THCa crystals that become psychoactive Delta-9 THC when heated, with minimal terpene content and maximum cannabinoid concentration. If specific brand verification is important, checking the product's accompanying COA before purchase will confirm the producer and batch-level potency.

faqs.q: Can THCa Diamonds be used to make infused flower or edibles?
faqs.a: THCa Diamonds can be used to create infused flower (moonrocks-style) by combining broken diamond pieces with concentrate oil and kief coating, or simply crumbling small amounts directly onto flower in a bowl for a potency boost. For edibles, it is important to note that THCa in its raw form is non-psychoactive — it must be decarboxylated (heated) to convert to THC before it produces psychoactive effects. Adding raw diamond material directly to cold food will not produce a significant psychoactive effect. To use diamonds in edibles, they must first be decarboxylated by heating in an oven at approximately 240°F (115°C) for 30 to 40 minutes, which converts the THCa to THC. Once decarboxylated, the material can be incorporated into fat-based edible preparations. Given the near-pure potency, extreme precision in dosing is required for edible use.

faqs.q: How do THCa Diamonds compare to THC distillate in terms of effects?
faqs.a: THCa Diamonds and THC distillate are both highly refined, high-purity cannabinoid concentrates, but they differ in cannabinoid form and processing. THCa Diamonds contain THCa in crystalline form — non-psychoactive until heated. Distillate typically contains Delta-9 THC (already decarboxylated) in a liquid form, sometimes with terpenes re-added. In practice when heated and inhaled, both deliver high-potency THC effects. The key differences are: diamonds have near-zero terpene content (flavour comes from any added terpene source); distillate is liquid-format and easier to load into cartridges but harder to handle as a standalone dab material. Diamonds suit consumers who prefer solid-format concentrates for dabbing or sprinkling on flower; distillate suits consumers who want pre-loaded cartridge convenience or oil-based versatility.

faqs.q: What is THCa flower and how does it differ from regular cannabis?
faqs.a: THCa (tetrahydrocannabinolic acid) is the raw, non-activated form of THC found in living and freshly harvested cannabis. Unlike THC, raw THCa is non-psychoactive, which allows THCa-dominant hemp flower to be legally sold in many jurisdictions under hemp legislation provided delta-9 THC remains below 0.3%. When THCa flower is smoked or vaporised, the heat converts THCa to THC through decarboxylation — producing the same psychoactive effects as traditional cannabis. THCa flower is chemically equivalent in effect to regular cannabis when consumed by inhalation.

faqs.q: What is Banana Kush's genetic background?
faqs.a: Banana Kush (Ghost OG × Skunk Haze) combines Ghost OG's OG Kush potency and physical ease with Skunk Haze's tropical-fruity-skunky aromatic complexity to produce a strain with genuine sweet-banana aromatic character. The banana terpene expression comes from specific isoamyl acetate-adjacent ester compounds in the Skunk genetics combined with Ghost OG's sweet citrus character. Banana Kush is indica-dominant with relaxing, mood-lifting effects and one of the most recognisably tropical-sweet aromas in cannabis.

faqs.q: Is THCa Banana Kush as effective as regular Banana Kush?
faqs.a: Yes — when consumed by inhalation (smoking or vaporising), THCa Banana Kush converts to THC with identical psychoactive effects to regular Banana Kush cannabis. The sweet banana-tropical aromatic character and indica-dominant relaxing effects are equivalent. The only difference is the legal status of the raw product, not the consumer experience when inhaled.

faqs.q: What does 'Z Cubed' mean as a cannabis strain name?
faqs.a: 'Z' consistently references Zkittlez (and related 'Z' cannabis naming — Zaza, Z strains) in modern cannabis nomenclature. 'Cubed' signals three-times intensity — Z to the power of three, suggesting the Zkittlez multi-fruit candy character amplified to cube-root intensity. Z Cubed is therefore an extremely vivid, intensified Zkittlez-family multi-fruit candy expression — the most candy-complex Z-genetics cannabis available.

faqs.q: Is Z Cubed Dogwalker 6-Pack appropriate for regular daily rotation?
faqs.a: Yes — Z Cubed's Zkittlez-family calming, focusing, and body-easing character at the THCa potency level makes it appropriate for regular daily personal use in the Dogwalker slim format. faqs.q: How was GG4 created?
faqs.a: GG4 (Gorilla Glue #4) was bred accidentally by GG Strains — a hermaphrodite Chem's Sister pollinated Sour Dubb and Chocolate Diesel plants, creating seeds that were initially discarded. A friend recovered the seeds and grew them out, discovering exceptional potency and aromatic quality. The numbered phenotype system (#1, #4) emerged from selecting the best-performing plants. GG4 (#4) was the standout, testing at 27–30% THC and winning multiple 2014 Cannabis Cups before GG Strains formalised the genetics.

faqs.q: Why does GG4 produce such sticky buds?
faqs.a: GG4's extraordinary stickiness comes from exceptional trichome density and resin production from its Chem's Sister genetics. The trichomes are so abundant that breaking up GG4 buds coats fingers in a thick, glue-like layer of resin — the direct inspiration for the 'Gorilla Glue' name. This resin density also means GG4 is particularly prized for concentrate extraction, where the high resin content produces exceptional yields of live rosin, bubble hash, and solvent extracts.

faqs.q: How does THCa GG4 compare to traditional GG4?
faqs.a: When inhaled, THCa GG4 converts from non-psychoactive THCa to THC through decarboxylation, producing identical effects to traditional GG4 — the same chocolate-diesel-coffee aroma, the same extraordinary stickiness, and the same powerful full-body relaxing hybrid effects that won multiple 2014 Cannabis Cups. THCa format offers legal accessibility in many jurisdictions without altering the consumed cannabis experience.

faqs.q: What is live rosin and why is it the premium tier of cannabis concentrates?
faqs.a: Live rosin is produced in two steps from fresh-frozen cannabis: first, ice-water extraction creates full-melt bubble hash; second, the bubble hash is pressed with controlled heat and pressure to produce rosin oil. No solvents are used at any stage. The result preserves the most complete terpene and cannabinoid profile possible — the living plant's full chemical expression at maximum fidelity. Live rosin represents the quality ceiling of cannabis extraction.

faqs.q: Why is live rosin in a cartridge particularly valuable?
faqs.a: Standard cartridges use distillate with terpenes re-added. Live rosin cartridges preserve the complete original terpene spectrum from fresh-frozen material — dramatically more complex, authentic, and complete than any distillate+added-terpenes cartridge. The difference is immediately apparent in the aromatic richness and the more nuanced, complete effect profile from the full terpene-cannabinoid entourage.

faqs.q: What temperature is optimal for live rosin in a cartridge?
faqs.a: Live rosin's delicate preserved terpenes are best expressed at lower voltages (2.2-2.6V) in 510-thread batteries. At lower temperatures, the complex terpene array is experienced at its most vivid and authentic. Higher voltages increase vapour volume but can mute the nuanced terpene character that makes live rosin premium. The Pyro Extracts ceramic battery in this catalogue is particularly well-suited for live rosin cartridge use.

faqs.q: How did UK Cheese's distinctive cheese aroma develop?
faqs.a: UK Cheese originated as a single Skunk #1 phenotype that developed an unusual cheese-pungent aromatic mutation sometime around 1989–1995 in Berkshire, UK (with the Exodus collective). This specific phenotype's terpene profile — high myrcene combined with specific sulphur-containing compounds and caryophyllene in an unusual ratio — produces the sharp, aged-cheddar-like pungency that made Cheese cannabis its own aromatic category. The original clone was propagated and spread throughout UK cannabis culture.

faqs.q: What is 'Exodus Cheese' and how does it relate to UK Cheese?
faqs.a: Exodus Cheese is the original Cheese phenotype clone, associated with the Exodus collective in the UK. For years, UK Cheese existed only as a clone (not from seed), propagated from the original Exodus phenotype. Big Buddha Seeds eventually created stable seed genetics (Big Buddha Cheese, by crossing the Exodus Cheese with Afghani), making the Cheese aromatic character accessible through seeds rather than requiring the original clone. UK Cheese typically refers to either the original clone or its closest seed-grown expressions.

faqs.q: What effects does UK Cheese produce?
faqs.a: UK Cheese's indica-dominant Skunk #1 heritage produces relaxing, happy, and mood-elevating effects — the classic Skunk body-ease and euphoric disposition, with the indica leaning toward physical comfort and eventual sedation. At 15–20% THC, UK Cheese is accessible and reliable — not overwhelming, but consistently effective for stress relief, pain management, and social relaxation.

faqs.q: What does 'Unicorn Poop' communicate as a strain name?
faqs.a: Unicorn Poop is ThugPug Genetics' whimsical naming choice for a strain that is, paradoxically, one of their most serious and potent creations. The name's magic is the contrast: something that would be magically strange and colorful if it existed (unicorn poop) represents a cannabis strain that is genuinely extraordinary despite its unusual naming. ThugPug (also responsible for Peanut Butter Breath) has a tradition of memorable, irreverent naming that obscures the serious genetic work underneath.

faqs.q: What do GMO Cookies and Sophisticated Lady contribute to Unicorn Poop?
faqs.a: GMO Cookies (Chem Cookies × Girl Scout Cookies or Do-Si-Dos × Chem Cookies) contributes its legendary garlic-fuel-mushroom-onion pungency and powerful sedating indica effects. Sophisticated Lady (a Do-Si-Dos × Girl Scout Cookies cross) adds its sweet, floral, and earthy cookie character that moderates GMO's aggressive pungency into something more complex and nuanced. The combination creates Unicorn Poop's unusual garlic-fuel-meets-floral-cookie aromatic profile.

faqs.q: Is Unicorn Poop related to Peanut Butter Breath?
faqs.a: Yes — both Unicorn Poop and Peanut Butter Breath were bred by ThugPug Genetics using GMO Cookies as one parent. Peanut Butter Breath uses Do-Si-Dos × Mendo Breath; Unicorn Poop uses GMO × Sophisticated Lady. They represent ThugPug's exploration of GMO Cookies crosses, each taking the GMO base in a different aromatic direction. Unicorn Poop emphasises the garlic-fuel dimension; Peanut Butter Breath emphasises the nutty-earthy dimension.

faqs.q: What does each cannabinoid in URB Boarding Skybites contribute?
faqs.a: The 65mg per gummy formula is carefully balanced for a functional 'boarding' (calm, focused, ready-to-engage) experience. D9 THC (5mg) provides mild mood elevation and gentle psychoactivity — the entry dose for perceptible but not overwhelming cannabis effect. CBD (25mg) provides the primary anxiolytic, anti-inflammatory, and grounding foundation. CBG (25mg) contributes focus-supporting, mood-brightening properties that complement the CBD base. CBC (10mg) adds anti-inflammatory and neurogenic properties. Together these create a functional multi-cannabinoid wellness formula that is more comprehensive than any single or dual cannabinoid product.

faqs.q: What are URB's True-Infused Terpenes?
faqs.a: URB's True-Infused Terpenes is a proprietary terpene infusion process that blends strain-specific terpene profiles into the gummy during manufacturing for authentic flavour fidelity and targeted effect character. Rather than adding generic flavouring, URB uses the same terpene profiles found in the effect-category cannabis strains — myrcene and linalool in Mixed Berry for the hybrid focus profile — creating a terpene-cannabinoid synergy designed to produce consistent, targeted effects rather than just pleasant flavour.

faqs.q: How does 5mg D9 affect daily functioning when combined with 55mg of non-psychoactive cannabinoids?
faqs.a: At 5mg D9 per gummy with 25mg CBD moderating the psychoactivity, Boarding Skybites is positioned as a functional, low-intoxication daily supplement. The CBD strongly moderates the 5mg D9's CB1 effect, and at this ratio most adult consumers with any cannabis experience will experience very mild, barely perceptible psychoactivity. CBG and CBC add their own non-psychoactive dimensions. URB specifically positions Boarding Skybites as appropriate for any-time functional use — including morning and professional contexts — due to the low D9 dose within the high non-psychoactive cannabinoid context.

faqs.q: Why is Peach Mango Watermelon the 'Relax' flavour in the Boarding Skybites range?
faqs.a: URB's True-Infused Terpenes system assigns terpene blends to each flavour for targeted effect profiles. Peach Mango Watermelon is powered by linalool (the primary terpene in lavender, with well-documented anxiolytic and sedative properties) and limonene (citrus terpene with mood-lifting and stress-reducing effects). Linalool specifically supports the relaxation and calming dimension of the indica profile designation — creating a gummy positioned for unwinding, evening relaxation, and transitioning from an active day to a restful evening.

faqs.q: How does Boarding Skybites Peach Mango Watermelon compare to URB's higher-potency lines?

URB's Take Off Skybites also delivers 10mg D9 per piece (pure D9), Cloud 9 Skybites delivers 100mg per piece (D8+D9), and Red Eye Skybites delivers 250mg per piece (D8+D9+THCP). Boarding is the accessible daily-wellness starting point in a tiered potency system; Red Eye is the extreme-potency destination.

faqs.q: Is the Peach Mango Watermelon flavour natural or artificial?
faqs.a: URB uses natural flavouring systems in their Skybites line. The Peach Mango Watermelon combination uses fruit-derived flavouring compounds from peach, mango, and watermelon sources to create the three-fruit combination. True-Infused Terpenes adds the linalool and limonene terpene profile during manufacturing rather than as a surface coating, ensuring consistent flavour and effect-oriented terpene content throughout each gummy.

faqs.q: What makes Tropical Breeze the 'Energy' flavour in Boarding Skybites?
faqs.a: URB pairs Tropical Breeze with limonene and pinene terpenes for a sativa energy profile. The limonene+pinene terpene profile supports an alert, energised, motivated state appropriate for productive mornings and active afternoons. faqs.q: How do the three Boarding Skybites flavours compare in effect direction?

faqs.q: What is the effect of 100mg D8+D9 per piece?
faqs.a: At 100mg total cannabinoids per piece (90mg D8 + 10mg D9), Cloud 9 Skybites are a high-potency product appropriate for experienced high-tolerance cannabis consumers. faqs.q: Why is Fruity Cereal a popular cannabis edible flavour?
faqs.a: Fruity Cereal captures the intensely sweet, artificial-fruit, milk-cereal character of beloved breakfast cereals — a deeply nostalgic flavour for most adults that creates an immediately positive, comfort-food sensory experience. In cannabis edibles, the bold sweetness of fruity cereal flavour effectively masks cannabinoid extract character while delivering a uniquely recognisable and enjoyable eating experience. Fruity Cereal is especially popular in high-potency gummies where the bold flavour compensates for the large extract concentration.

faqs.q: What does 'Knockout Punch' reference in this gummy's name?
faqs.a: The name works on two levels: the flavour reference is a classic fruit punch — the multi-fruit tropical-citrus-berry combination of punch-style candy and beverages. faqs.q: How should I store Cloud 9 Skybites for maximum shelf life?
faqs.a: URB recommends storing their gummies in resealable packaging in a cool, dry place away from heat and direct sunlight. Proper storage maintains freshness, potency, and consistency for up to 12 months. High-potency gummies like Cloud 9 at 100mg per piece benefit from consistent storage conditions — heat can cause cannabinoid degradation and gummies to stick together. Keep sealed and away from children and pets.

faqs.q: Is Cloud 9 Knockout Punch better vaped or eaten?
faqs.a: Cloud 9 Skybites are specifically designed as edibles — they are meant to be eaten, not vaped. As an oral edible at 100mg per piece, Cloud 9 produces the long-onset (45–90 minutes), long-duration (6–10 hours), high-intensity effect characteristic of oral cannabis consumption where D8 and D9 are converted to hydroxy metabolites in the liver. This is categorically different from vaping. Never attempt to vape cannabis gummies.

faqs.q: What does prickly pear taste like in a cannabis gummy?

It is less intensely fruity than strawberry or raspberry and more subtly sweet and exotic. When paired with watermelon in Cloud 9 Skybites, the prickly pear's floral sweetness complements watermelon's clean summer sweetness, creating an unusually sophisticated and distinctive dual-fruit profile.

faqs.q: Is Prickly Pear Watermelon a seasonal flavour for URB?
faqs.a: URB offers Prickly Pear Watermelon as a signature flavour across multiple product lines — it appears in both Cloud 9 Skybites and URB's main D9 gummy range, suggesting it is a core flavour rather than a seasonal limited edition. URB also uses it in their Take Off Skybites, indicating consumer demand for this distinctive flavour combination across multiple potency tiers.

faqs.q: Why is Prickly Pear Watermelon particularly well-suited to high-potency gummies?

faqs.a: At 1:1 D9:CBD (15mg each per piece), the CBD significantly moderates the D9's psychoactivity through CB1 receptor competition and serotonin system effects, producing a more balanced, anxiety-reduced, and physically grounded experience than 15mg pure D9 alone. URB specifically brands this format Gummy Getaway Aruba with a 1:1 ratio for consumers who want meaningful D9 euphoria and wellness alongside CBD's therapeutic benefit — neither pure CBD's non-intoxicating wellness nor unmodified strong D9 psychoactivity.

faqs.q: Is Dragonfruit Kiwi Watermelon the most complex flavour in URB's range?
faqs.a: Yes — the three-component combination of dragonfruit (floral-exotic), kiwi (tart-tropical), and watermelon (clean-sweet) creates the most layered and complex flavour profile in URB's edible lineup. Each fruit contributes a distinct character: dragonfruit adds exoticism and delicate sweetness; kiwi adds green tropical tartness; watermelon adds refreshing clean sweetness. The combination covers exotic, tart, and refreshing flavour dimensions simultaneously.

faqs.q: How does Gummy Getaway Aruba compare to Gummy Getaway Jamaica?
faqs.a: Gummy Getaway Jamaica delivers pure D9 at 10mg per piece (35ct, 350mg total) — straightforward D9 cannabis experience. Aruba is higher per-piece D9 than Jamaica (15mg vs 10mg) but with CBD moderating the psychoactivity. Choose Jamaica for straightforward 10mg D9 daily dose; choose Aruba for balanced 15mg D9 + 15mg CBD wellness with more complex per-piece formulation.

faqs.q: What does dragonfruit taste like in a cannabis gummy?
faqs.a: Dragonfruit (pitaya) has a subtly sweet, mildly tropical flavour often compared to a cross between kiwi and pear — less intensely flavourful than strawberry or mango but with a distinctive exotic character and beautiful natural magenta colouring. In cannabis gummies, dragonfruit's delicate sweetness creates a sophisticated and memorable flavour experience that is genuinely different from common berry and citrus options. faqs.q: How does Dragonfruit Paradise compare to Dragonberry Lemonade in URB's range?

Dragonfruit Paradise lets the dragonfruit character lead more purely, delivering the exotic, tropical fruit experience in a cleaner, sweeter format without the citrus-tart competition of lemonade. faqs.q: What are the effects of 10mg D9 per piece in URB gummies?

faqs.q: Why does URB use Peach Mango Watermelon across multiple product lines?

faqs.q: Is 10mg D9 in a non-nano gummy slower-acting than Mood's nano products?

Mood's nano-formulated products (Rapid Onset, Morning, Sleepytime) achieve 5–15 minute onset through water-soluble nanoemulsification. Both formats are valid — URB's standard format is more economical and provides the same long-duration (4–8 hour) experience; nano products are more immediately practical.

faqs.q: Is Take Off Skybites suitable for first-time cannabis edible consumers?
faqs.a: At 10mg D9 per piece, Take Off Skybites is at the moderate end for first-time cannabis edible consumers. True cannabis beginners should start with half a gummy (5mg D9) and wait the full 90 minutes before assessing. The Skybites format provides reliable, consistent dosing per piece making Take Off more appropriate than variable-dose alternatives for new D9 consumers.

faqs.q: What's the difference between Take Off Sour Blueberry and Jamaica D9 Sour Blueberry?

faqs.q: How does the Skybites production process improve the gummy quality versus standard D9 gummies?

faqs.q: Does sour coating affect the shelf life of URB Take Off gummies?

For best texture preservation, store Take Off Sour Blueberry sealed in a cool, dry location away from humidity — refrigeration is generally unnecessary but may help in very warm/humid climates. faqs.q: When should I take URB Landing Skybites for best sleep effect?

faqs.q: What is THCP and why does its presence in Red Eye Skybites matter so much?
faqs.a: THCP (tetrahydrocannabiphoral) is a naturally occurring phytocannabinoid structurally identical to THC but with a seven-carbon alkyl chain versus THC's five. Research indicates THCP binds CB1 receptors with up to 33 times greater affinity than Delta-9 THC. In Red Eye Skybites, even a relatively small THCP contribution to the 250mg total dramatically amplifies the overall formula's effective potency beyond what the D8+D9 milligrams alone would produce. This is why Red Eye is classified Sky High Strength despite competitors having similar total milligrams without THCP.

Consumers should have established experience with standard D9 gummies (5–10mg per piece), then higher-dose D8/D9 products (25–50mg), before considering Red Eye at 250mg with THCP enhancement. The extreme potency of Red Eye can be genuinely overwhelming for consumers without this progression. Start with URB's Take Off or Cloud 9 Skybites and work up progressively over multiple sessions before considering Red Eye.

faqs.q: Why is passion fruit a particularly good match for THCP gummies?
faqs.a: Passion fruit's intense, complex aromatic profile — floral, tart, tropical, and distinctively exotic — creates a flavour experience rich enough to complement the potent cannabinoid formula of Mile High Skybites. THCP's powerful effect warrants a flavour that is equally memorable and distinctive, and passion fruit's intensity fits this role. The exotic character also reinforces URB's 'sky high' elevated positioning — passion fruit is an inherently elevated, aspirational tropical flavour.

faqs.q: Is Passion Fruit Mile High Skybites the same as the Red Eye Passion Fruit Mango?
faqs.a: No — these are very different products. Red Eye Skybites Passion Fruit Mango delivers 250mg per piece (D8+D9+THCP) at extreme potency for high-tolerance consumers only. Mile High Skybites Passion Fruit delivers 5mg per piece (2.5mg nano D9 + 2.5mg THCP) — a much lower nominal dose but still potent due to THCP's 33x CB1 amplification. Mile High is the more accessible entry into THCP; Red Eye is the extreme end.

faqs.q: Can I take Mile High Passion Fruit Skybites on an empty stomach?
faqs.a: Yes — the nano D9 component in Mile High Skybites is specifically designed to absorb effectively without food, as nanoemulsification bypasses the fat-digestion requirement of conventional cannabinoid edibles. However, THCP's potency may be more intensely felt on an empty stomach with faster gastric emptying. For first-time Mile High users, taking with a light meal may provide a more gradual and manageable onset while the nano THCP formula develops.

faqs.a: Strawberry Lemon is the most balanced sweet-tart option in the Mile High range — it hits both the sweet dimension (strawberry's warmth) and the tart dimension (lemon's citrus bite) more equally than the other flavours. Blue Razz skews more tart-forward; Guava Smoothie is smoother and less tart; Passion Fruit is intensely aromatic; Watermelon Juice is clean-sweet. Strawberry Lemon is the most broadly accessible dual-character flavour for consumers who enjoy both sweet and citrus dimensions.

In URB's specific catalogue, Strawberry Lemon appears in Mile High Skybites as one of their signature THCP range flavours. The combination's broad consumer appeal makes it a logical choice for URB's premium THCP product line where flavour satisfaction alongside potency is important.

faqs.q: What precautions are most important for first-time Mile High Skybites consumers?
faqs.a: The critical precautions are: (1) Start with exactly one piece — not two, regardless of prior cannabis experience. (2) Wait the full nano onset window (15–30 minutes for initial effects, 60 minutes for full effect assessment) before considering more. (3) Ensure you are in a safe, obligation-free environment with no driving, machinery operation, or critical professional responsibilities for at least 6–8 hours. (4) Have food and water available. (5) Do not combine with alcohol or prescription CNS depressants. THCP's potency amplification makes these appropriate only for consumers with established THC tolerance.

faqs.q: What does each active ingredient in VIIA Revive contribute?
faqs.a: CBD (90mg) provides the primary anxiolytic, anti-inflammatory, and mood-stabilising foundation. CBG (10mg) amplifies the CBD's entourage effect and adds its own mood-brightening and focus-supporting properties. Reishi mushroom extract contributes adaptogenic stress-hormone regulation and immune support. 5-HTP (5-hydroxytryptophan) is a serotonin precursor — the body converts 5-HTP directly into serotonin, potentially supporting mood elevation and stress reduction through the same pathway as some antidepressants. L-Theanine is an amino acid found in green tea with documented anxiolytic and focus-supporting effects, promoting calm alertness without sedation.

faqs.q: Why does VIIA Revive include 5-HTP in a CBD gummy?
faqs.a: 5-HTP is a clinically studied natural serotonin precursor that has shown efficacy for mood support, anxiety reduction, and even sleep improvement in research settings. By adding 5-HTP to the CBD+CBG formula, VIIA creates a multi-mechanism mood-support gummy — the cannabinoids engage the endocannabinoid system while 5-HTP supports serotonin production through the monoaminergic system. Together these mechanisms provide broader mood and stress support than cannabinoids alone.

faqs.q: Can VIIA Revive Relief gummies be taken daily?
faqs.a: Yes — VIIA recommends taking 1 Revive gummy in the morning or before daily tasks as a daily wellness supplement. The THC-free formula means no psychoactivity or impairment, making it appropriate for professional and active daytime contexts. CBD, CBG, Reishi, 5-HTP, and L-Theanine are all generally safe for regular long-term use at the doses in Revive. VIIA notes effects last 2–4 hours per gummy, suggesting 1–2 gummies per day for sustained all-day benefit.

faqs.q: Why does VIIA lead with CBG rather than CBD in Flowstate?
faqs.a: VIIA Flowstate is a focus and energy formula, and CBG's specific receptor pharmacology makes it more appropriate as the lead cannabinoid for cognitive goals. CBG's interactions with alpha-2 adrenoceptors, serotonin receptors, and its role as a 'stem cell' cannabinoid from which others derive, give it distinct focus-supporting and mood-brightening properties that CBD's primarily CB2 and serotonin 5-HT1A profile doesn't as directly target. The 25mg CBG at lead position with 35mg CBD supporting creates a CBG-directed focus formula with CBD's anxiolytic grounding.

faqs.q: What does Lion's Mane mushroom add to Flowstate?
faqs.a: Lion's Mane (Hericium erinaceus) has the strongest clinical evidence of any functional mushroom for cognitive support, specifically through stimulation of Nerve Growth Factor (NGF) — a protein essential for the growth and maintenance of neurons. Regular Lion's Mane consumption has been studied for improving memory, concentration, and cognitive processing speed. Combined with CBG's focus-supporting cannabinoid action, Lion's Mane creates a dual-mechanism cognitive enhancement formula — cannabinoid-based attention support plus mushroom-based neurogenic support.

faqs.q: Is VIIA Flowstate better for creative work or analytical tasks?
faqs.a: Flowstate's CBG + CBD + Lion's Mane formula with no psychoactive THC is well-suited to both creative and analytical work. The CBG contributes the motivation and mental brightness appropriate for creative sessions; the Lion's Mane's neurogenic support enhances the sustained concentration needed for analytical tasks; CBD's anxiety reduction benefits both by removing the mental static that interferes with either type of focused work. VIIA positions Flowstate for 'flow state' achievement — the absorbed, effortless concentration that benefits all types of demanding mental work.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Wana Quick Relax and Wana Relax (standard)?
faqs.a: Wana Quick Relax uses nano-emulsification for 5–15 minute onset — the premium fast-acting format. Standard Wana Relax uses conventional hemp extract requiring 45–90 minutes for onset through standard digestive absorption. Both deliver the same relaxation formula and 300mg total cannabinoid content; the Quick version provides faster onset at a premium price. Choose Quick Relax for on-demand, precisely timed relaxation; choose standard Relax for gradual, sustained relaxation with advance planning.

faqs.q: Why is Blueberry Lemonade one of the most popular cannabis gummy flavours?
faqs.a: Blueberry Lemonade perfectly balances two complementary flavour dimensions: blueberry's sweet, deep berry warmth and lemon's sharp, palate-brightening citrus tartness. The combination creates a refreshing, multi-layered flavour that avoids being one-dimensionally sweet or tart. Cannabis edibles specifically benefit from this balance because the citrus-berry combination effectively masks hemp extract notes while delivering a genuinely enjoyable eating experience. Blueberry Lemonade appears consistently in top cannabis edible flavour rankings.

faqs.q: How many Wana Relax gummies should I take?
faqs.a: Wana recommends starting with one gummy and waiting the full 45–90 minute onset window before considering more. The relaxation formula's per-piece dose (approximately 10mg of the total 300mg total per piece if 30ct) is calibrated for a single piece to produce noticeable but manageable relaxation. Consumers seeking stronger effect after establishing their response to one piece may take two pieces of subsequent sessions.

faqs.q: What makes Wappa significant as a Paradise Seeds creation?
faqs.a: Paradise Seeds is one of the oldest and most respected Dutch seed banks, known for quality indica genetics. Wappa emerged as one of their most celebrated indica-dominant creations — consistently praised for its sweet-fruity aroma combined with deep hash-indica effects. It has placed in multiple Cannabis Cup competitions and remains one of Paradise Seeds' signature strains, representing Dutch seed bank excellence in creating reliable, flavorful, and therapeutically effective indica cannabis.

faqs.q: What does Wappa's aromatic profile include?
faqs.a: Wappa's terpene profile produces an unusually sweet and fruity aromatic character for an indica with Afghan hash genetics — myrcene provides the fruity-earthy base, caryophyllene adds spicy depth, and the overall combination creates a sweet-hash aromatic that is more approachable and pleasant than many hash-lineage indicas. The fruity sweetness over hash earthiness makes Wappa particularly appealing to consumers who want indica therapeutic effects in a more aromatic, pleasant package.

faqs.q: Is Wappa good for pain management?
faqs.a: Yes — Wappa's Afghan-indica genetics produce reliable analgesic properties alongside its relaxing, calming effects. The myrcene-rich terpene profile contributes to the physical body ease and pain relief; the indica genetics provide the comprehensive CB1-mediated analgesia. Wappa is frequently recommended in the medical cannabis community for chronic pain, arthritis, muscle spasms, and insomnia.

faqs.q: What are Triangle Kush and Animal Mints and how do they create Wedding Cake?
faqs.a: Triangle Kush is the heavy Florida OG Kush phenotype known for powerful indica sedation and earthy-fuel OG character. Animal Mints (Animal Cookies × SinMint Cookies × GSC) provides the minty-cookie dimension, additional GSC-derived sweetness, and the euphoric-creative effect quality. Wedding Cake combines Triangle Kush's heavy OG indica foundation with Animal Mints' sweet-cookie-mint aromatic lift, producing the vanilla-cake-earthy flavour and the powerful yet balanced effects that won Leafly's 2019 SOTY and spawned Ice Cream Cake, Cake Crasher, and dozens of other celebrated descendants.

faqs.q: Why is Wedding Cake so foundationally important in modern cannabis?
faqs.a: Wedding Cake (2019 Leafly SOTY) became a foundational breeding parent almost immediately — its perfect balance of OG Kush indica body effect and Cookie-family dessert sweetness made it the ideal base for further crossing. Ice Cream Cake (Wedding Cake × Gelato 33, Seed Junky) is one of the most popular strains globally; Cake Crasher (Wedding Cake × Wedding Crasher), Slayer Cake, and dozens of 'Cake' named strains follow. Wedding Cake's influence on 2020s cannabis genetics rivals OG Kush's influence on 2010s genetics.

faqs.q: Is Wedding Cake appropriate for new cannabis consumers?
faqs.a: At 25–27% THC, Wedding Cake is at the higher end for cannabis newcomers. The indica-dominant character and high potency can be overwhelming without established tolerance. For experienced consumers it represents an excellent everyday premium indica; newcomers should start at much lower doses and assess before consuming more.

faqs.q: How does Purple Punch change the Wedding Cake experience in Wedding Crasher?
faqs.a: Standard Wedding Cake is already a heavy indica-dominant hybrid at 25–27% THC. Adding Purple Punch (Larry OG × Granddaddy Purple) deepens the indica sedation significantly — GDP's famous sleep-promoting properties compound Wedding Cake's already heavy physical effects. Purple Punch also adds its signature blueberry-muffin-grape-sweet aromatic dimension on top of Wedding Cake's vanilla-cake character, creating a richer, more complex dessert-berry-cake aromatic profile in Wedding Crasher.

faqs.q: Why is Wedding Crasher a popular parent strain for further breeding?
faqs.a: Wedding Crasher, like its Wedding Cake parent, has become widely used in further breeding because it combines the best of both parents — Wedding Cake's sweetness and potency with Purple Punch's grape-berry appeal and additional visual purple colouration genetics. Cake Crasher (Wedding Cake × Wedding Crasher) is one notable descendant. The grape-meets-cake aromatic profile translates well to further crosses, making Wedding Crasher a versatile genetic base.

faqs.q: Is Wedding Crasher a daytime or evening strain?
faqs.a: The compounded indica genetics from both Wedding Cake and Purple Punch make Wedding Crasher firmly an evening and nighttime strain. The heavy euphoria and deep physical relaxation build progressively into significant sedation — appropriate for pain management, insomnia, and deep unwinding, but counterproductive to daytime productivity.

faqs.a: White genetics (The White, White Widow, or White Truffle lineage) contribute extraordinary trichome density — the 'white frost' visual character that makes White-named cannabis visually spectacular. Cherry genetics add sweet-berry-cherry aromatic warmth and pleasant fruity depth. Truffle genetics (White Truffle or Black Truffle) add deep earthy-luxury complexity that contrasts with the cherry sweetness. Together they create White Cherry Truffle's three-character aromatic profile: frosty-sweet-earthy complexity.

Potency in the 20–25% THC range is consistent, and the bud structure is dense and properly cured. faqs.q: What effects does White Cherry Truffle AAA produce?

faqs.q: What is 'Gorilla Butter' and how does White Truffle relate to it?
faqs.a: Gorilla Butter is the direct cross of GG#4 (Gorilla Glue) and Peanut Butter Breath. White Truffle is a specific phenotype of Gorilla Butter — selected for its distinctive earthy-truffle aromatic character, extraordinary trichome coverage ('White' referring to the white-frost trichome density from GG4 genetics), and balanced indica-leaning effects. BeLeaf's popularisation of the White Truffle phenotype made this particular Gorilla Butter expression one of the most sought-after premium strains in the US market.

faqs.q: How does the White Truffle aroma differ from standard GG4?
faqs.a: Standard GG4 produces a chocolate-diesel-earth-chemical aroma. The Peanut Butter Breath crossing in Gorilla Butter moderates this toward earthier, nuttier, and more mushroom-adjacent character — and White Truffle phenotype selection specifically emphasises the truffle-earthy-complex dimension rather than GG4's diesel character. The result is an unusual, sophisticated earthy-nutty-chemical complexity that justifies the 'truffle' naming.

faqs.q: Is White Truffle appropriate for daytime use?

faqs.q: Why is White Widow one of the most enduring cannabis strains globally?
faqs.a: White Widow's 1995 Cannabis Cup victory established it as the benchmark balanced hybrid, and its subsequent dominance in Amsterdam coffee shops introduced it to cannabis consumers worldwide for decades. Shantibaba's Brazilian Sativa × South Indian Indica cross produced a strain with exceptional resin production (the 'White' referring to the white trichome frost that covers the buds), powerful balanced effects, and consistent growing properties. Its descendants — White Rhino, Blue Widow, White Berry — further extended the lineage's influence.

faqs.q: What does 'White' in White Widow refer to?
faqs.a: The 'White' in White Widow refers to the extraordinary white trichome coating on the buds — so dense that the flowers appear white or silver from trichome crystal coverage. This visual characteristic became the defining aesthetic of the White family of cannabis strains. At good quality cultivation, White Widow buds are visually spectacular — the white trichome frost covering dark green buds creating a distinctive frosted appearance.

faqs.q: Is White Widow appropriate for new cannabis consumers?
faqs.a: White Widow's balanced 50/50 hybrid character and consistent effect profile make it more accessible than pure heavy indicas or intense sativas. At 18–25% THC, new consumers should still start conservatively, but the balanced euphoric-and-relaxing character without extreme sedation makes White Widow a reasonable introduction to premium cannabis for consumers ready to move beyond starter products.

faqs.q: Why is pomegranate specifically chosen for Wyld's Restore/recovery formula?
faqs.a: Pomegranate is one of the most antioxidant-rich fruits available — high in punicalagins and punicic acid, compounds studied for their anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and recovery-supporting properties. Wyld's use of real pomegranate in their Restore formula is nutritionally intentional: pomegranate's anti-inflammatory properties complement the CBD and D9's own anti-inflammatory cannabinoid effects, creating a gummy where both the cannabinoids and the real fruit ingredient contribute to the physical recovery and restoration application.

faqs.q: How does the 1:1 D9:CBD ratio serve the Restore/recovery application?
faqs.a: For physical recovery — post-exercise soreness, injury recovery, chronic pain management — the equal D9+CBD ratio provides the most comprehensive cannabinoid-based anti-inflammatory and analgesic coverage. D9 activates CB1 receptors for pain modulation and central nervous system pain signal reduction; CBD engages CB2 receptors for peripheral anti-inflammatory action and TRPV1 receptor-mediated pain relief. The equal ratio maximises both pathways simultaneously, producing more complete pain and inflammation relief than either cannabinoid provides alone.

faqs.q: Is Wyld Pomegranate Restore appropriate for post-workout recovery?
faqs.a: Yes — Wyld specifically positions Restore for physical recovery contexts. The 10mg D9 per piece produces relaxing, physically easing effects appropriate for post-exercise muscle recovery, while the 10mg CBD provides anti-inflammatory support for exercise-induced muscle damage. The real pomegranate provides natural antioxidants that support cellular recovery. Take one Restore gummy within 30–90 minutes of completing exercise, after hydrating, to begin the cannabinoid absorption while the natural recovery window is active.

faqs.q: What makes the D9+CBG formula different from the more common D9+CBD?
faqs.a: Most hemp gummies use D9+CBD because CBD is the most abundant and well-documented hemp cannabinoid. Wyld's Refresh formula substitutes CBG for CBD — a meaningful formulation choice. While CBD primarily provides anxiolytic, anti-inflammatory, and sedation-moderating effects, CBG specifically adds focus-supporting, mood-brightening, and alerting properties through its interactions with alpha-2 adrenoceptors and serotonin receptors. The D9+CBG combination produces a more energised, uplifted, motivated experience than D9+CBD, making Refresh appropriate for daytime and active-use contexts.

faqs.q: Why is pear the flavour choice for Wyld Refresh?
faqs.a: Pear's clean, light, slightly crisp sweetness is refreshing and appropriate for a daytime-use gummy — less heavy than tropical fruits and less tart than citrus, pear's gentle character suggests clarity and freshness. Wyld uses real pear for authentic flavour depth. The pear-refresh flavour association is natural in culinary contexts (pear juice as a refreshing drink), and the flavour mood-match with the energising CBG+D9 Refresh formula is intentional across Wyld's product design philosophy.

faqs.q: Can I take Wyld Pear Refresh gummies for cognitive work during the day?
faqs.a: Yes — Wyld's Refresh formula is one of their daytime-appropriate options. The 10mg D9 per piece produces moderate psychoactivity (making assessment of personal response in non-professional contexts first important), but the CBG component specifically supports the focused, motivated, clear mental state appropriate for cognitive work. For truly professional daytime use, Wyld's lower-dose Active formula may be more appropriate; Refresh's 10mg D9 per piece is for consumers with established D9 tolerance who find this dose compatible with productive daytime function.

faqs.q: Why does Wyld use elderberry specifically for their sleep formula?
faqs.a: Elderberry carries strong cultural and functional associations with immune health and bedtime wellness — elderberry syrup is a widely used traditional remedy for colds and immune support, making elderberry an apt flavour choice for a nighttime supplement. Wyld uses real elderberry for both the authentic flavour depth (deep, slightly tart, earthy berry complexity) and the subtle nutritional associations. The elderberry character is also more sophisticated and evening-appropriate than brighter, sweeter berries like strawberry.

faqs.q: How does 5mg CBN per piece contribute to sleep when combined with 10mg D9?
faqs.a: CBN at 5mg adds a meaningful sedative dimension alongside the D9's own sleep-promoting properties. D9 THC at 10mg reduces sleep latency (time to fall asleep) and can increase slow-wave sleep depth; CBN adds its own distinct sedative channel through CB1 and other receptor interactions that specifically promote drowsiness. The 2:1 D9:CBN combination creates a deeper sleep effect than D9 alone — the CBN's sedation persists alongside the D9's physical relaxation for more complete sleep support.

faqs.q: How does Wyld Elderberry Sleep compare to Wyld Dark Cherry Calm?
faqs.a: Both are evening/relaxation formulas from Wyld but with different intensity and CBN content. Wyld Calm Dark Cherry (270mg total, low-dose D9 ≈2mg + CBD + CBN) is a gentle calming formula with low D9 for broad consumer accessibility. Wyld Elderberry Sleep (100mg D9 + 50mg CBN, 10mg + 5mg per piece) is a stronger sleep formula with 10mg D9 per piece — more psychoactively meaningful and more strongly sleep-directed. Calm is for general evening relaxation; Sleep is for consumers specifically targeting sleep onset and quality.

faqs.q: How does Wyld differentiate Active Sativa from their Playful Hybrid or Mellow Indica lines?
faqs.a: Wyld uses specific terpene profiles and cannabinoid blends to direct each D9 formula toward distinct effect characters. Active Sativa (Raspberry) uses sativa-associated terpenes (limonene, terpinolene, pinene) that amplify the energising, cerebral dimension of the 10mg D9. Playful Hybrid (Huckleberry) uses balanced hybrid terpenes for even, moderate effects across all dimensions. Mellow Indica (Marionberry) uses indica-associated terpenes (myrcene, linalool) that direct the D9 toward physical relaxation and sedation. Same 10mg D9 per piece across all three — the terpene profile drives the experience direction.

faqs.q: Why is raspberry the designated Wyld sativa fruit?
faqs.a: Wyld consistently uses raspberry to represent their sativa/active line — raspberry's bright, energetic tartness and vivid colour create sensory associations with vitality, outdoor activity, and daytime energy. The crisp tartness of real raspberry contrasts with the softer, heavier character of elderberry or marionberry (used in the calming and indica lines), reinforcing the Active Sativa positioning through flavour-mood congruence. Real raspberry provides genuine depth that artificial raspberry flavouring cannot achieve.

faqs.q: Can I take Wyld Active Sativa Raspberry gummies before exercise?
faqs.a: Yes — Wyld's Active Sativa formula is specifically designed for physical activity contexts.
